text: The full message reads: "Balloon is landing safely.

name: ac8f55b133153a3e
text: Coming HOME!"

name: e47a41490e31f897
text: You spotted a repeating pattern, a doubling number pattern, used logic to order the words, and cracked a shift code.

name: d00b7b259d7b9d5e
text: The scientists can collect their balloon.

name: 76cd1785a8ae4804
text: Brilliant decoding!

name: a729d1da49eee4d0
text: Nobody took the puddle.

name: fd9cc2e32e680c89
text: Warm sunshine and a breeze turned its water into invisible water vapour, which rose into the air.

name: 4b71c029437b3b9b
text: One day it will cool, form clouds and fall as rain.

name: 3e277bc6cd5f50ec
text: That puddle water may come back!

name: 1d4fd5ce5af1cc38
text: A chewed wire had made a gap between test points 2 and 3, so electricity could not flow around the loop.

name: 27f507b921a848d1
text: Keeper Mina switched off the power and mended it with new copper wire.

name: 434325092963d3b9
text: The light shines over Pebble Bay again!

name: 3775933d340e6b1c
text: Captain Zuri visited Mars and Jupiter, then saw the rings of the giant planets on her way home.

name: 7cea346b1e3a8a75
text: Each planet has its own clues, from red dust to giant storms.

name: ef6841311ca40773
text: Knowing the facts solved the case!

name: e47a160446b5eab8
text: A sea turtle came ashore after high tide, laid her eggs in the warm sand and went back to the sea.

name: a04b8bed39673e84
text: Ranger Tala marked the nest and turned off the bright beach lights.

name: c0f238416940bb8b
text: The tracks told the whole story!

name: 0054ad959702b1f9
text: Yesterday the dough rose beside the warm oven, but today it sat by an open window on a cold morning.

name: 70de989ee37c7a33
text: Yeast works slowly in the cold, so it made too few gas bubbles.

name: ade4bf6a9046edd2
text: Baker Bo moved the dough somewhere warm, and the fluffy loaves came back!

name: 8da5628bb8d8b2a3
text: A beehive beside Row C was moved away in the spring, so few bees visited its flowers.

name: 815b8997f723824d
text: Without pollination, flowers cannot turn into apples.

name: 0eb75a1b5cd9acf7
text: Farmer Lin brought the hive back and planted wildflowers.

name: 68cf2214a17e22b6
text: Next year, Row C will be full of fruit!

name: 4c9c2b773bf0afe2
text: First, what makes a shadow?

name: 574537b6ba4335e4
text: Light travels in straight lines.

name: e4a01b9ee3f8a1ef
text: A solid object stops it, and the dark area behind the object is its shadow.

name: 16a65c792ba40fc7
text: Light cannot bend around the toy, so a shadow forms.

name: 2d1ee83f98d54333
text: Put the photos in order, from early morning to evening.

name: ff3de9fc8f59795e
text: At dawn the Sun is low in the east, so the shadow is long and points west.

name: fe2298e6582d0125
text: By evening it points east.

name: f56f86f8e3835a85
text: It is shortest around midday.

name: d7bf4238c5707cef
text: Near the Equator, as in Ghana, the midday Sun is almost overhead, so midday shadows are tiny.

name: 4869c4b8e94aa762
text: Three captions came with the photos.

name: 29cdddafcb9fa4cf
text: Which one cannot be true?

name: 53798f927653d522
text: Around midday the Sun is at its highest, so a very long shadow cannot be from then.

name: 7c3df157a3ba3ae3
text: The caption must be a mistake.

name: 3ca7870dc6214315
text: A high Sun makes a short shadow, not long.

name: 8c5043d4c0ca2953
text: Which of these are true about shadows and the Sun?

name: dc9e974aea07520e
text: The Earth spins, so the Sun seems to cross the sky, and shadows change.

name: 21262303bff4679d
text: People have used that to tell the time for thousands of years.

name: cbe99aa3e9482a86
text: C: A shooting star.

name: ec13f684932d684a
text: D: Twelve.

name: 701eca13c351c70f
text: A: A pilot.

name: a3a57d774d534d13
text: A: Mars.

name: c53da644678cd9da
text: Which planet is called the Red Planet?

name: 21d6d6f7def5079a
text: B: Mercury.

name: 6d42111dd57a2e47
text: A: Mercury.

name: a2ae069563b05120
text: A: Steam.

name: 12ace0b65d5d4959
text: D: Salt.

name: 27a8f7a41d1f5c59
text: C: A pilot.

name: 023ea0dca6f12f28
text: B: Carbon dioxide.

name: 7aa69bc9ac70d8c7
text: D: Helium.

name: 604e16f052792786
text: D: Eight.

name: 7cd6288734ad5193
text: B: Salt.

name: c79fc764a22b346c
text: C: Sand.

name: 887ec59424c6d47b
text: B: Melting.

name: 036a56839292b2d7
text: Fewer wrong picks earn more stars.

name: 039f25e7b637aade
text: A fungus, which is not a plant at all.

name: f1226852090485ea
text: What state of matter is it?

name: 8ccb5fb1d19f6db0
text: Go down through the Earth's layers, starting at the surface.

name: 0956f1a3e41bc3e3
text: You earned 155 points and the Pollination Pro badge!

name: 0de8d8e1e5eb0e34
text: You earned 165 points and the Circuit Sleuth badge!

name: 74eb0ef8e444c2d8
text: You earned 165 points and the Beach Ranger badge!

name: 265946e31f4fd84a
text: You earned 165 points and the Planet Tracker badge!

name: 1608973a67566b1e
text: You earned 150 points and the Water Cycle Detective badge!

name: e14808b79d28c888
text: You earned 150 points and the Signal Decoder badge!

name: c1a1c64b2f96d9d6
text: You earned 150 points and the Bakery Scientist badge!

name: 4d989b07cb129908
text: D: Hot, warm and cold.

name: 6ae024c62944a8c9
text: B: Steam.

name: 19dc88dc72f5fb53
text: C: Pollination.

name: 184583800fd6f5b2
text: A: The horse.

name: c0e19dd3ee7723c2
text: B: Your brain.

name: c07fa7f1d6177c93
text: B: The North Star.

name: 8ab5048abcc7edc1
text: B: One.

name: b0825271fa40a4d9
text: C: Twelve.

name: 53200bb2a927d342
text: B: Seven.

name: 2a69c7f68cecb4f8
text: C: Wind.

name: 4a8d15d8894f470b
text: B: Oxygen.

name: 91df6bcdaab48288
text: Yes! plant.

name: 69147fd9a28b1bd6
text: You found Stegosaurus!

name: d974bf7a67d07a0c
text: Your code works!

name: f0cdca0e1b848911
text: The robot reached the flag.

name: 4362158b2f425d5d
text: When your half leans towards the Sun, it is summer.

name: f5c60a0c344f69d9
text: Chameleons change colour to show their mood and to warm up or cool down.

name: 7b9c60b3d24c5c16
text: Grown-ups have 206 bones.

name: 1fbbdc636380b3b2
text: Children have 20 baby teeth.

name: f2337ab3305ef588
text: Let's keep that private!

name: 891d980b8e6603ae
text: You never need to tell me your address, phone number, password or full name.

name: ddbebc0d3f2c9aea
text: Ask me about animals, space or science instead!

name: a758aafb12f64eb2
text: Pitter, patter, the rain came.

name: 06a5031a74d2e8a3
text: It washed the dust off every petal, and the whole meadow sparkled.

name: c51ec7755e43d1eb
text: Then the sun came out behind you, and a rainbow appeared in front of you, right over the dripping trees.

name: d3a41b58975deb9e
text: The flowers were bright again, even brighter than before.

name: 727a8fb62d01382d
text: "Waiting was the hardest part," Fennel laughed, shaking raindrops off her spines.

name: bfaaf4109ec03298
text: After the Rain

name: 5121e7326803d01d
text: You see a rainbow when the sun is behind you and rain is in front of you.

name: 9fa3f41c1cefacdc
text: Cup by cup, you carried water.

name: ec1e3bde4025eaf6
text: Squirrels joined in, then beetles, then a very slow snail.

name: 5a10fcb3e199a40c
text: Every flower you washed lit up with colour: red poppies, yellow buttercups, blue bells.

name: 373a965cc8e60422
text: It took all afternoon, and by the end, everyone in Hue Wood had helped.

name: aa8b9a7f331ededf
text: Fennel was tired but grinning.

name: c91b2559ef2fffc5
text: "This is the most colourful the wood has ever been!"

name: f3c431d067eac406
text: The Bucket Brigade

name: 56b4984b5bd81b31
text: Dust blocks light.

name: a2291571b9c73294
text: When the light can reach the flowers again, their colours show.

name: 439e8f3d22b4be75
text: Far away, on the purple Planet Luma, you and Buddy are running a little science camp under two suns.

name: dfa89b4b2ed65431
text: Tonight, something unusual crackles over the radio.

name: 9caa009285cd05b5
text: You get to decide how to investigate.

name: be4589b66fbc2e27
text: Beep beep.

name: f055d0708a84e4ad
text: Beep beep beep.

name: 1dab78fecec37e07
text: The camp radio has been quiet for weeks, but now it is picking up a signal.

name: 392a891fb20da1ba
text: The beeps come in groups, with little pauses in between.

name: 814fbd5a76ec4ec4
text: Outside, the two suns of Luma have set, and the sky is full of stars.

name: 435c31fb6c21f636
text: Beyond the camp rises Glow Ridge, the tallest hill around.

name: 3606710cbcd5a825
text: From the top of the ridge, the signal comes through loud and clear.

name: 3b6e5d2d77a50f9c
text: Radio signals travel best when there are no hills in the way, so up here nothing blocks it.

name: 2a80d5d2135a4175
text: Far below, in a round crater, a tiny light is blinking: on, off, on, off.

name: bb5eff4453c1bb83
text: It blinks in the same groups as the beeps.

name: fda82a88bf3335e2
text: You write down each group: two beeps, then three, then five, then seven.

name: b5664a88dd56bb0b
text: "These are prime numbers," Buddy says.

name: 238db6357fe2128c
text: "Numbers that can only be divided by one and themselves."

name: 03fdda117a0b3cee
text: Nature rarely makes prime number patterns like this by itself, so someone, or something, must be sending them on purpose.

name: 24319d3ab0cb0227
text: The radio's antenna can point towards where the signal is coming from.

name: 6cfa6ea6e175320d
text: In the middle of the crater sits a small, dusty rover with one blinking light.

name: 30b4baa987949333
text: Painted on its side is a name: DOT.

name: 651736cc1e5af527
text: Its screen flickers: "Battery low.

name: 762952c78015600f
text: Lost.

name: a916d77d68bbacf6
text: Please help."

name: 2258c4796546dbb1
text: Dot was left here long ago by explorers and has been calling out ever since.

name: 97dbb7f3ed6627c5
text: Its solar panel is covered in purple dust, and one wheel is stuck in the sand.

name: 6e9bc63dc879f588
text: The blinking light in the crater stops, then flashes back faster and faster, as if it is excited!

name: 81006cecd0482260
text: Then it starts to move.

name: e352947826aa01b3
text: Up the slope rolls a small rover called Dot, which explorers left behind long ago.

name: 18d757e794fcf187
text: It has been looking for a friend to answer its signal for years.

name: cfb000b11e5ffee4
text: Now Dot follows your torch all the way to camp.

name: 8924dada26ae8b67
text: Light Talk

name: 40f71192d4c155fe
text: Light can carry messages too.

name: 2b7ff039fab1bdae
text: Flashing patterns are one of the oldest ways to signal over long distances.

name: 38e9a554a7a0edcf
text: The radio goes quiet.

name: 05dd470a1a1f7eb5
text: Then, beep, thirteen beeps: the next prime number!

name: 360d3cf7ed9fe4ef
text: Whoever is out there understood you.

name: 04802cb34fcc12d4
text: A picture slowly appears on the radio screen, dot by dot: a map, with a path from your camp to a crater.

name: f83ee064621ac9cc
text: Waiting at the end is a little rover called Dot, and it has a store of star charts to share.

name: 364e022b071fbf9f
text: The Number Map

name: dcb86817f482d4dc
text: Maths works the same everywhere, so scientists think numbers could be a way to talk with anyone in the universe.

name: cbffdfe1495bb5fa
text: You wait with Dot through the night, telling stories.

name: 1d437249e59cfadd
text: When the first sun rises, its light hits the clean solar panel.

name: 5ba23732ec2ef503
text: Then the second sun rises, and Dot's battery fills even faster.

name: 2184dc6cff4fad10
text: Its lights blink green, and it rolls out of the sand all by itself.

name: 8f54c2b69f4c93da
text: Dot plays a happy little tune of beeps.

name: ec4c9bc3ecc32ac9
text: Sunrise Recharge

name: 94b4a44641dc4068
text: Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity, and dust can block the light, so keeping them clean helps.

name: 24c14d696f22edc7
text: Dot is heavy, but Luma has weaker gravity than Earth, so it is easier to pull than you expected.

name: fef506def41abd1d
text: Step by step, you tow Dot all the way to camp.

name: 0e830e3d09c59c27
text: You plug it into the camp battery, and Dot's screen lights up: "Thank you, friend."

name: d7500209f0bf71a4
text: Now the science camp has a new helper.

name: 2f12cf8bf1da82bb
text: The Long Tow Home

name: 04cf063af1ff3f9f
text: On a planet with weaker gravity, things weigh less, so heavy loads are easier to lift and pull.

name: 77e5cacf20571592
text: In a cosy shed at the bottom of a garden lives Pim, a mouse inventor no taller than a teacup.

name: 03c5f1bbea6da4b5
text: The garden is very dry, and Pim has a big idea.

name: 99184d09f2ffb2d6
text: You help choose how to build it.

name: bf64c7c5d545c21c
text: It has not rained for weeks.

name: f78b4e72c9bc70b2
text: The sunflowers are drooping, and the only water is deep down in the old well.

name: 4ac0cb25806f7b7c
text: "I am going to build a machine to bring the water up!" says Pim, waving a pencil.

name: 6f9be5317b86af53
text: Pim has drawn two plans.

name: d6828e80980e077f
text: One is a windmill that pumps water.

name: 4e87497f06bd36cb
text: The other is a bucket on a rope, lifted by a wheel called a pulley.

name: 9585c1e237945e67
text: The windmill is ready.

name: 1a84c7c46f2dbd5f
text: Pim holds it up to the breeze and, flop, the paper blades just bend backwards.

name: 62aea3d6381f487d
text: They barely turn.

name: c006d20268aa3419
text: Pim is not upset at all.

name: f78fb20bc42422e7
text: "That is why inventors test things," Pim says.

name: 6d4a87f6f345faac
text: "Now we know what to fix."

name: 5c11da2fcc9903d8
text: There are two ideas: make the blades stronger, or move the windmill to the windy hill.

name: 4d2d17e477a5743d
text: Pim hangs the thimble bucket over the well on a single wheel and pulls.

name: 03dbb5eec4982807
text: The full bucket is heavier than Pim!

name: ee6ae51e6e971fcd
text: The rope slips, and splash, the water spills back down.

name: 565fb3b2a34c6409
text: "Hmm," says Pim, twitching her whiskers.

name: 8f2627dc314bc25b
text: "I need the machine to do some of the work."

name: 057f20530f8fe1ee
text: In the corner of the shed are a spare wheel and a smooth, heavy pebble.

name: 2d24c7c021d1902d
text: With folded blades, the windmill spins round and round, and water begins to trickle up the straw pipe.

name: f076ebc441aff248
text: Drip, drip, drip.

name: f0d66f330f574bd9
text: But it is slow, and the wind keeps stopping and starting.

name: a91c2e92a7258f8a
text: The sunflowers need a lot of water.

name: 7ad8aa60b04382cd
text: "Maybe the windmill needs a way to save water for later," Pim wonders, "or maybe it needs some friends."

name: a937cd53318d5a6a
text: On the hill, the wind is so strong that the windmill spins like a top.

name: 0cba35baa31d3508
text: Water gushes up the pipe!

name: 06a305f59731cf14
text: But the hill is far from the sunflowers, and the gusts make the windmill wobble.

name: 2cd946caad5944f7
text: A snail and a family of ants have stopped to watch.

name: f0dc832dae1bbf32
text: "Wow," says the snail.

name: 130bee2b89dc930e
text: "Can you make one for us too?"

name: 214d2c5e93d7fb6a
text: All night long, while the wind blows, the windmill slowly fills the teapot tank.

name: 264ccf68ec583f02
text: By morning, it is full to the brim.

name: 2c054996fb056f45
text: Pim pours water onto the sunflowers, and they lift their heads to the sun.

name: e2ab53121978fba5
text: Now, even when the wind stops, there is always water saved up.

name: 0f66624081f01e82
text: Pim writes in a notebook: "Windmill, version two.

name: 408231def5302349
text: It works!"

name: 2c159735b68b6f33
text: The Teapot Tank

name: 548f98147d8a9ee5
text: Storing energy or water for later helps when nature is not steady, like wind that starts and stops.

name: 541db260a2cf76d1
text: The ants measure, the snail holds things steady, and the beetles carry sticks.

name: 79ff92cfea53c22c
text: By sunset, a row of little windmills stands across the garden, each one pumping water to a different flower bed.

name: 4c2ff1803b77e43d
text: The sunflowers stand tall again.

name: 7b7df52910ae9465
text: Pim beams.

name: 7dc476e6380b6d60
text: "A big idea is even bigger when everybody adds to it."

name: 49f8d0fc62046222
text: The Whole-Garden Machine

name: 40a984de6cc85f8c
text: Engineers often work in teams, and lots of small machines working together can do a very big job.

name: 52095d0ea0b4824f
text: With the string looped around a second wheel that rides on the bucket, Pim pulls again.

name: f94f9ab10d5f934b
text: This time the bucket rises easily!

name: 63bcb60dc3961b79
text: Pim has to pull twice as much string, but it only takes half the effort.

name: 3b4e278ff5e13e67
text: Bucket after bucket comes up, and soon every sunflower has had a long drink.

name: 473d3bf57bdf2c99
text: "More wheels, less work," Pim squeaks.

name: d2c5ce589ecc60f8
text: Two Wheels Lighter

name: 274c300b7f48067a
text: Pulleys with more wheels trade distance for effort: you pull more rope, but with less force.

name: 066e8aaf7dbaced1
text: The pebble is almost as heavy as a full bucket.

name: f532da6b64feb744
text: Now, when Pim gives a small tug, the pebble goes down and the bucket comes up, like a seesaw.

name: 0714e86e7a7e3c5b
text: Lifts in tall buildings use this same trick!

name: d66577701db651d3
text: Pim waters the whole garden before lunch and still has time for a cheese sandwich.

name: e495c8898fba6724
text: The Pebble Balance

name: d30a0060cd8d539c
text: A counterweight balances a load, so only a small push is needed to move it.

name: c657eb02e2e5f276
text: Real lifts use one.

name: c707874682390c0f
text: Deep in the blue Sapphire Sea, a young whale called Coral was learning to sing.

name: d87a32d3c51e5cab
text: But today her family has swum far away, and she cannot hear them.

name: fa18a6f6d00458b2
text: Let us help her, and you decide what happens next.

name: a4c8c5c2900d3535
text: Coral floated alone in the blue water.

name: 027fc3f92be0403d
text: "I sang, but nobody answered," she said.

name: 812cf1abb2294ff2
text: Pip the little pilot fish swam by.

name: 9851415deaf43b6c
text: "Sound travels a very long way underwater," said Pip.

name: d61ba5f38e8288b4
text: "Far faster than in air!

name: a020b0861d8ee9c4
text: Maybe you need a better place to sing."

name: 447f1529438f9478
text: Coral looked down at the dark, deep water, then up at the bright reef nearby.

name: 1a567564570d3b32
text: Down here the water was calm and still.

name: ca5b8f291a5cff0a
text: Coral hummed a low note, and it rolled away into the blue.

name: d94271684ace4fea
text: "Low sounds can travel hundreds of kilometres," said Pip.

name: 007745221c0522ee
text: Coral could sing louder here, or she could stop and listen carefully for a reply.

name: 0d8a79bc90bdd10d
text: The reef crackled and popped with life!

name: fecfa54f1bd566d8
text: Tiny shrimp snapped their claws, and fish chattered.

name: 128f20cd4adfe85e
text: "It is so noisy here," said Coral.

name: f0767bd580635b98
text: An old sea turtle paddled past.

name: 0dc9598b654a5c0f
text: "I passed your family near the warm current," she said.

name: 8b371aaf6a04203d
text: "Or you could ask the dolphins.

name: 9e8d41c0e5f3ddad
text: They are very good at sending messages."

name: 941b037950bc47df
text: Very faintly, a long, low song drifted through the water.

name: 35183e5ebe38f86a
text: "That is Grandmother!"

name: 777d7816b927966f
text: Coral cried.

name: 2562947715d16fd7
text: "Whale families can have their own calls," said Pip.

name: ecca3d554704084b
text: "That is how you know it is yours."

name: 5868d29e1eaef873
text: Coral could swim straight towards it, or sing the family song back.

name: 4e33243e3a23b27b
text: Far across the sea, the family heard Coral, and they sang back!

name: efe34c44720efc59
text: Their voices came closer and closer, until huge friendly shapes appeared in the blue.

name: cbcd6293bec34907
text: Coral nuzzled her grandmother, and they all sang together.

name: e23c5f7d77049e15
text: The Family Song

name: 49a15274e9b075e7
text: Low sounds travel a very long way through water, so whales can call to each other across huge distances.

name: 2fca28a4b27e3565
text: The dolphins raced off, passing the message from pod to pod.

name: d462e8da116db052
text: Before long, Coral's family came swimming over the horizon, led by a dolphin doing happy flips.

name: cca7138dd3d22c8e
text: "You are never alone in the sea," said Grandmother, "as long as you have friends."

name: 3d894c669cc6fbc7
text: Friends Across the Sea

name: 0295b42102ed6679
text: Dolphins use clicks and whistles to talk, and many sea animals live in groups and help each other.

name: 9e059a23107575ef
text: Coral swam for hours, stopping at the surface to breathe through her blowhole.

name: 8e988de2f025ec0a
text: The song grew louder with every stroke.

name: e0e59ff6d04e56b5
text: At last, she saw her family ahead.

name: a744880de1aeb176
text: "You followed your ears all the way here," laughed Grandmother.

name: 32d89871a46c101f
text: "You are growing up!"

name: 3431e057711da850
text: Following Her Ears

name: 6c9e693a008795d0
text: Whales are mammals, so they breathe air at the surface, and they rely on sound to find their way in the sea.

name: c3cfbaea6c4c6aaa
text: High in the snowy north, Nell the Arctic fox has noticed something odd.

name: a9e3795c4841782c
text: Every snowflake that lands on her nose has exactly six sides.

name: 038fa8c67aa006ed
text: Soft snow was falling over Frost Hill.

name: 15fd978dd79adf74
text: Nell caught a flake on her black nose and peered at it with her magnifying glass.

name: 8d2c872ccbcd532f
text: "Six sides again!" she said.

name: 14f246de6fbae60c
text: "Why is it always six?"

name: 14c609b1c9a3e8dd
text: Up on the hill stood the Weather Hut, and down by the lake old Walrus was mending a sledge.

name: 809eb47c26f5f835
text: Inside the hut, Professor Puffin had drawn water on a chalkboard.

name: b74dd4ef7c11e757
text: "When water freezes, its tiny parts join up in a pattern of six," the professor said.

name: cad945da418e90f6
text: "So every ice crystal starts with six sides."

name: 2fda86da7c1a2870
text: Nell wondered what happens next.

name: 3d1d8df8d1bdb6a6
text: Should she catch more flakes, or grow an ice crystal herself?

name: 8ebdac7ef03ec2f9
text: "Snowflakes?

name: 7dc3887fbacf8916
text: I just shovel them!"

name: 0f1ff111174146de
text: Walrus chuckled.

name: 2db0bbf444f7a78e
text: "But look at the frost on my sledge."

name: 7e3b590547cd2923
text: Feathery patterns spread across the metal like tiny ferns.

name: 6fabc1650b868f99
text: "They grow from the air when it is very cold," said Walrus.

name: 122d94a559546d01
text: The lake had a new sheet of clear ice too.

name: 652817e495dbed47
text: "New ice is thin," said Walrus, "so we never walk on it."

name: d31b264e6ebe45b7
text: Nell laid out twenty flakes.

name: 588098e9f5a594cb
text: All had six sides, but they all looked different!

name: 324caf51364e1669
text: Some were plates, and some were stars with long arms.

name: 3cd32b83178e1198
text: "Each one takes its own path through the cloud," said Professor Puffin, "so each one grows a little differently."

name: ae52ab7dbf0e05fe
text: Nell wanted to tell everyone.

name: c38583cb4a0d8ce3
text: Everyone in the valley came to see Nell's drawings of snowflakes.

name: b2a9ae6e2dc252c5
text: The little lemmings cheered, and Professor Puffin gave Nell a tiny medal made of pine cone.

name: 6e64abeb9450f000
text: "You looked closely," the professor said, "and that is what scientists do."

name: 7c7f97a6e89cbdac
text: No Two Alike

name: 509813d375355b86
text: All snowflakes begin with six sides, but each one takes its own path through the clouds, so each grows differently.

name: 4a30d7b626ac4916
text: Slowly, feathery crystals spread across the cold glass, branching again and again.

name: 08f6de527f1c90e8
text: "Water vapour in the air turned straight into ice," said Nell.

name: 002cc7fbf34da513
text: "It did not even become water first!"

name: 106c3e5478dc3277
text: She drew every pattern in her notebook, while the sun rose and made the frost sparkle.

name: 1e17ebda8994448f
text: Crystal Ferns

name: 953059d51c2275c2
text: On very cold surfaces, water vapour can turn straight into ice, growing frost crystals with no liquid water at all.

name: 08d0404b6c9b5d22
text: Under the clear ice, fish were swimming calmly.

name: ac14c3bc694301e0
text: "Ice floats!" said Nell.

name: a1312fd8cf829c92
text: "Most liquids shrink as they freeze, but water spreads out in its six-sided pattern, so ice is lighter."

name: e3076f27991a61eb
text: Walrus nodded.

name: aca6a6bddcd7f0df
text: "And it keeps the lake below from freezing solid.

name: 4ba19f8e79b93a54
text: Handy for the fish!"

name: 43c9afbf07ed81ac
text: The Ice Blanket

name: 6da40d30e79e557f
text: Ice floats because water spreads out as it freezes, and a layer of ice helps keep the water below it from freezing.

name: 8b03ee67c9091658
text: Bumble the honeybee has found the most wonderful meadow, far beyond the old stone wall.

name: f6409548bb9a8b1f
text: But how can a little bee tell the whole hive where it is?

name: 1af52f052f3cf3ba
text: Bumble buzzed from flower to flower, full of sweet nectar.

name: 1dd1d7b218973905
text: "The whole hive has to see this!" she said.

name: fb9d6a4e066a24f0
text: But bees cannot talk.

name: 4762180b4a2e9124
text: Back at the hive, Old Queenie was the wisest bee of all.

name: 88a137c833266499
text: Close by, a line of ants marched past, following a trail to some food.

name: b6e6f31ddb94649d
text: "Use your body, little one," said Old Queenie.

name: 0bb2cb28ddef593f
text: "Dance!"

name: 968b8fd6c44eb8ee
text: She showed Bumble a figure of eight with a wiggle in the middle.

name: 43333bd896fd62c0
text: "The angle of your wiggle points the way, compared to the Sun.

name: e56c81898645c92f
text: The longer you wiggle, the further away the flowers are."

name: 72e6e376d7b310ad
text: Bumble gulped.

name: d659dd8c489c0231
text: The meadow was very far.

name: 91684210d1e7b46b
text: "We leave a scent trail on the ground," said a busy ant.

name: e2b7d80ef23e8133
text: "Everyone just follows the smell!"

name: 7e9f71febaad28c6
text: Bumble looked at her wings.

name: 4c8181df9b6bb683
text: "But I fly," she said.

name: 94f7cd23e86bc88d
text: "I cannot leave a trail in the air."

name: 140773ceb32520a4
text: The ant shrugged.

name: ca84c290652c6af9
text: "Then at least share the smell of your flowers."

name: 3964a104a2dcac49
text: Bumble shared the flower scent, and the other bees sniffed eagerly.

name: ee66ac4da9286aef
text: Now they knew what to look for, but not where to go.

name: a4a41424c78afa63
text: Some wanted to set off and search.

name: 7a3f7ce32ba2e750
text: Others wanted Bumble to lead them there herself, or dance the way.

name: 44e84b435a36803f
text: Bumble wiggled and turned, over and over.

name: ca37dd04a378b941
text: Her sisters pressed close, feeling her steps in the dark.

name: 77686d408cd6ba01
text: Then, one by one, they flew straight to the meadow!

name: 0a8fd6251b6e67a1
text: Soon a stream of bees was carrying nectar home.

name: b5511329a4167881
text: "Your dance was a map," said Old Queenie.

name: 6217cd3deb2c7d3a
text: The Dancing Map

name: f36315ca6b77b50a
text: Honeybees really do a waggle dance.

name: 58c1faed74cceea1
text: It shows other bees which way to fly compared to the Sun, and how far to go.

name: b16bfebbd112802a
text: Bumble led her team past the old stone wall, and there it was!

name: d5f4502578ef96c7
text: The scouts filled up on nectar, and pollen dusted their furry legs.

name: 2ac3ab4376a4ecff
text: As they buzzed from bloom to bloom, the meadow grew even more beautiful.

name: a34de5c2a9ed7d07
text: "We carried the pollen," they said, "and the flowers will make seeds."

name: 297bb167e30ad7b7
text: The Pollen Helpers

name: 7044af915ecae4d7
text: As bees collect nectar, pollen sticks to their furry bodies.

name: 2e91ae3fc2b031c2
text: Carrying it from flower to flower helps plants make seeds.

name: 524fe21d8793e05e
text: Bumble passed the nectar to the house bees, who fanned it with their wings.

name: c668f791aadd5664
text: Hour by hour, it grew thick and golden, and the bees sealed it into the honeycomb with wax.

name: e9950b9b19b2a8cd
text: "This will keep us fed all winter," said Old Queenie.

name: 16d89b56cc77c126
text: Bumble smiled.

name: e88bf8cdb6cddcb1
text: A meadow in the sun had become a store of sunshine.

name: 0b10685f304c4bf0
text: Honey for Winter

name: b3538b443c348c16
text: Bees make honey by fanning nectar until most of its water dries out, then store it in wax cells to eat in winter.

name: 39a08864dcf99378
text: In a warm cave lives Zephyr, a small, gentle dragon.

name: 3047d79cf6d323a8
text: Every dragon sneezes sparks, except Zephyr, who sneezes bubbles!

name: 0eb514c53309d692
text: Zephyr wishes they would last longer.

name: c956a7737990fc1d
text: "A-CHOO!"

name: c6dfec7f4cd39c9a
text: A stream of shining bubbles floated through the cave.

name: aa25d1620a78032b
text: Each one was perfectly round.

name: 3dbe0c894e4d39bd
text: Then, pop, pop, pop, they were gone.

name: 7947c64d8bf28f88
text: "Why do they pop so fast?" sighed Zephyr.

name: 98aae2be06536904
text: In the corner, Mole had a jar of soapy water.

name: 42a900a334b8e1ee
text: Outside, a cool, misty morning had begun.

name: 5f7febff5c206119
text: "A bubble is a thin skin of soapy water with air inside," said Mole.

name: ebfabd67334a7347
text: "The skin pulls itself tight, like a stretchy balloon.

name: dd5b5e8a4f5cf423
text: That is why it goes round."

name: a5fe4b4eb378808c
text: Mole added a drop of syrup.

name: 483835f9d7d0ce9a
text: "Or we could try a bigger wand," Mole said, holding up a loop of wire.

name: 185e1e99aee0ad6b
text: Zephyr sneezed into the damp air, and the bubbles floated much longer!

name: 1a9c79a46fe75db3
text: "Bubbles pop when their water dries up," said Mole, hurrying out behind you.

name: 143a7c58ef531732
text: "Damp air slows that down."

name: 33e86556d544be90
text: The sun was coming up now, and the first bubbles began to show pale colours.

name: 8d5946d050291b8c
text: Zephyr blew gently, and a wobbling bubble grew and grew, as big as a boulder!

name: f324488845ec534d
text: It stretched into long shapes, then pulled itself back into a ball.

name: c9b457856997d00c
text: "It always wants to be round," said Mole.

name: b9e4d236dfa2ab29
text: Should Zephyr try to make it stronger, or simply watch it float away?

name: c1ab20f573f275be
text: The syrup slowed down the drying, and Zephyr's new bubbles lasted and lasted.

name: d5b605b6fd9b8d96
text: They bounced softly off Mole's nose!

name: d09b2f687df7688d
text: All the animals came to play.

name: f422d9de5d1e332f
text: "You are the best dragon in the whole mountain," said the rabbits.

name: 38399c3bc10804a3
text: The Lasting Bubbles

name: 65d7e89f07c782e9
text: Bubbles pop when their thin skin of water dries out, so sticky syrup helps them last longer.

name: d2ac08f5aa97b908
text: In the sunshine, swirls of pink, gold and green slid across the bubbles.

name: 074cc381acf47a95
text: "The skin is so thin that it splits light into colours," Mole said softly.

name: 3fbbba85f3d70222
text: Zephyr laughed and sneezed again.

name: 304ce2d8b66bb56d
text: Now the whole valley shimmered with tiny rainbows.

name: 132d89f7f9566525
text: Sparks were never this pretty!

name: 4af1734ebc3ac0d4
text: The Rainbow Sneeze

name: ee2d48a9de25cafa
text: Colours swirl on bubbles because light bounces off both sides of the very thin soapy skin.

name: 426e61d89041e093
text: "Why does it always go back to a ball?" asked Zephyr.

name: b5f07a066a04359c
text: Mole smiled.

name: 01f30de499a7130b
text: "The skin pulls itself as tight as it can.

name: 13a9a49846623478
text: A ball holds the most air inside the smallest skin."

name: 95de8164f57278bc
text: Zephyr tried to sneeze a square bubble, and laughed as it wobbled back into a ball.

name: b8b520474204c329
text: Some things just know their shape!

name: 4227e4e9c7de5926
text: The Perfect Ball

name: be81711c0296c74f
text: Bubbles are round because their stretchy skin pulls tight, and a ball holds the most air inside the least skin.

name: 2d84ca4007db52f2
text: On a hill stands a tall tower where Stella the owl keeps watch over the night sky.

name: d59120c27bea61a0
text: Tonight, one of her star maps does not match the sky.

name: a467dd69d3e104cd
text: Stella spread her oldest star map across the floor.

name: 2eb1565ddcd26af6
text: "How strange," she hooted.

name: e9dae0a050834988
text: "The stars in the Great Bear seem to have moved a tiny bit."

name: 26ec68be52e29905
text: In the corner stood a long brass telescope.

name: 202abdce18ac24f9
text: Beside it, a shelf held thousands of notebooks from all the owls before her.

name: 9d8604f54a008527
text: Thousands more stars appeared!

name: c0afd38cb081086d
text: "Light from these stars left them long ago," said Stella.

name: 479f7889d3c32901
text: "Some of it has travelled for hundreds of years to reach your eye."

name: b4b6197c19a43f34
text: You gasped.

name: 88f98df1dce5fc7e
text: So you were looking back in time!

name: 6ea3523da9190e02
text: One very bright light shone near the horizon.

name: 42edf8264cbd8d76
text: A fuzzy patch glowed above it.

name: 51086fafba4588e9
text: The notebook was a thousand years old, and its stars were in slightly different places.

name: df90f23212a7d42e
text: "Stars are moving all the time," said Stella, "but they are so far away that it takes ages to notice."

name: 6f66a865564e459d
text: You could copy the stars onto a new map, or go to look for a blinking light outside.

name: 26c13fe518acd7cb
text: The light did not twinkle like the others.

name: 8e065bd67b703f9b
text: It shone with a steady glow.

name: e08c5c1863312c0d
text: "Stars twinkle because their tiny points of light are jiggled by our air," said Stella.

name: 31f72022426f67c1
text: "That is the planet Venus!"

name: cade15bf6b55afb9
text: Now you wanted to explore further, or to mark everything you had found.

name: d9c99489181490c4
text: "That patch is a whole galaxy of stars," Stella whispered.

name: c33e85ceb20d37ed
text: "Its light left over two million years ago, long before people like us were around to see it.

name: 4cda4a025b9ee6f9
text: And tonight, it landed in your eye."

name: a4971ec78a7c066d
text: You stood very still, looking up at the oldest light you had ever seen.

name: fcd3f3d63b505f13
text: The Oldest Light

name: c7ea8846522a4357
text: Light takes time to travel.

name: c3eaf264eef6221e
text: The Andromeda galaxy is so far away that we see it as it was over two million years ago.

name: f07e9795bcd3d128
text: By dawn, the new map was finished, with Venus marked in gold.

name: 773225677266bda8
text: Stella gave you a new title in the book of owls: Star Friend.

name: 3dab601db7df47b0
text: "In a thousand years," she said, "someone will read this, and see how the sky has changed."

name: 16f3d81d38653be7
text: Star Friend

name: 07cc0b9affb75f22
text: Stars move very slowly across the sky.

name: d6490f9ac0045e16
text: Careful records help scientists see changes that take many lifetimes.

name: 4a70acb192420420
text: You and Stella stepped out onto the balcony, and let your eyes get used to the dark.

name: 4916c41f72168ba3
text: Then, whoosh!

name: 61fda94b55148ca6
text: A bright streak flashed across the sky.

name: 4d885a356513138b
text: "A shooting star!" you gasped.

name: c5202236a1f3cdf4
text: Stella hooted softly.

name: b8aabe37c24420ea
text: "It is not a star at all.

name: cfc5aa8cb8bacae3
text: It is a speck of space dust, burning up high in our air."

name: fc156715e56f78a3
text: The Speck of Dust

name: 34c9bbb9e83bc94c
text: Shooting stars are meteors: tiny bits of space dust that glow as they rush through the air high above us.

name: 033d8e31c983fcee
text: In a snowy valley, Tessa the tortoise has noticed steam rising from the mountain.

name: 51a15d4ffa0dc8aa
text: Snow is falling, yet one place never freezes.

name: 86aa5a0dfa6d8af4
text: A curl of white steam rose from the side of the mountain.

name: 84969ef4f530d049
text: "Why is it warm up there?" asked Tessa.

name: b80c98a28c96aadf
text: "Everything else is frozen."

name: 29e1695d1c6150e0
text: A stony path wound up to the steam.

name: 2e0a234eb689b2e3
text: Beside the frozen river, Mina the mouse was digging a little tunnel to stay warm.

name: ee34f57bcbe66aa7
text: The stones on the path felt warm, and the snow around them had melted.

name: fd1d6d0c3ec403e4
text: Tessa sniffed.

name: f776483a8be13968
text: "Eggs?" she said, wrinkling her nose.

name: 012b6e52bd7d26e2
text: Ahead lay two trails: one to a small steaming pool, and one to a crack in the rock that whistled softly with steam.

name: f55412fedc26f0dc
text: "Some hot pools are hot enough to burn," said Tessa, "so we only look, and never touch the water."

name: 1b7362d22f3b98c1
text: "The deeper I dig, the warmer it gets," said Mina.

name: 5ccb5011051be862
text: "Snow is a blanket, you know.

name: fa97d44ec9b16246
text: And the ground is warmer far below."

name: 6a98d8b6d281b442
text: Tessa thought about that.

name: eea7e2218cc73427
text: "Then how warm is it deep under the mountain?"

name: de33626335307c2b
text: Mina shrugged.

name: eba555f3d4381bcf
text: "Ask the river.

name: 3bd533a8cdd774a8
text: Part of it never freezes."

name: 9df0984e63687c68
text: Mountain goat Ama stood watching from a ledge.

name: 61efc5223832941c
text: "Rain sinks deep into the ground," she said, "where the rock is hot.

name: 65eb8a30012f36c5
text: It heats up and rises again as steam."

name: ea5a756f6bfdf486
text: She nodded at the valley.

name: 2bd28d6743bb8e36
text: "My family comes here every winter."

name: 809130a54688831c
text: You could follow her, or stay and draw.

name: b9ffccdedabf023f
text: There it was: a pool of warm blue water, with snow all around it.

name: aab355a63d571711
text: A family of snow monkeys were sitting in it up to their chins, looking very pleased.

name: 5a50abecd978d6b6
text: "Rain sank down, the hot rock warmed it, and up it came," said Tessa.

name: 56c5b53843d6c401
text: "The mountain has its own bath!

name: 5536c67f53e4583a
text: We will just watch.

name: 75774b69bd157090
text: People only bathe where grown-ups say it is safe."

name: a67cb54d8bc0c1ea
text: The Mountain's Bath

name: 85343dce14e04566
text: Hot springs form when water sinks deep underground, is warmed by hot rock, and rises back to the surface.

name: 4a80252721036fd7
text: Tessa marked every warm stone and steaming crack.

name: 20dd7827d3dde462
text: Soon the valley animals used her map to find the cosy spots on the coldest days.

name: 5a4ce498e4d3bc21
text: "Warmth from deep in the Earth," said Mina, snuggling up on a warm stone.

name: 71404792bddeae0b
text: "And it is free for everyone."

name: 41fc04796e7fc60b
text: The Warm Map

name: 91cabf24c73e7c7d
text: Heat from deep inside the Earth is called geothermal energy.

name: 0e3e1df605e22b77
text: Some countries use it to warm homes.

name: 5c09fd9e08bf6c45
text: From a safe distance, you all waited and watched.

name: bde762de3fa7e80b
text: The crack hissed and gurgled.

name: ce20b088993f70b3
text: Then, with a whoosh, a tall fountain of hot water shot into the air, and rained down on the rocks.

name: ae36c8d40abb7cb7
text: "Water trapped below heats up until it bursts out," said Ama.

name: f9dad156b824fcf1
text: "It will do it again soon."

name: c179cf8ebe1a86ad
text: The Mountain Fountain

name: e375ac08109c392d
text: A geyser shoots out hot water when water trapped underground is heated by hot rock until it bursts upwards.

name: a5933d1af861b54c
text: On a windy hill stands a dandelion, and on it is a tiny seed called Tuft, ready to leave home.

name: a540befbd9f6ad03
text: Plants cannot walk, so how will Tuft travel?

name: e219f8f5c31547ed
text: Tuft the seed held on tight to the dandelion clock, with a fluffy parachute above.

name: becab5cead5b30bc
text: "Why do I have to leave?"

name: 650c44c49fe3f5ea
text: Tuft asked.

name: 16e2c1d9cc270a61
text: "So you can find your own patch of sun," said Mother Dandelion.

name: 1beaaee87afd629f
text: "Too many plants in one spot have to share."

name: a329e46d0b90aa55
text: A gust blew past.

name: 527a257b43d1ead4
text: A rabbit hopped closer.

name: 593f9c804b1a9a9b
text: Tuft floated high above the fields, the fluffy parachute catching every breeze.

name: 754fad453afa9dab
text: Below was a sparkling river on one side and a sunny garden wall on the other.

name: 62994c993fd2816a
text: A burr seed drifted past.

name: 76020696cead9afa
text: "I travel by fur," it said.

name: 65a17ab9c343d67b
text: "Hooks are the best!"

name: b8324efb7a5d1d6f
text: Where would Tuft come down?

name: 3816369db36072b2
text: The rabbit bounced across the meadow, and Tuft bounced too!

name: aad768c598b1cfa3
text: Burr seeds were hooked in its fur all around.

name: 50241d680388a959
text: "Animals carry lots of us," said a burr.

name: a41f0de631e15896
text: "Berries get eaten, and their seeds come out somewhere new."

name: a45e67cd050a6594
text: At the river, the rabbit stopped to drink, then scratched its ear.

name: 565336b4c9fa8dfc
text: Tuft floated along like a tiny boat.

name: 07baff9b9c631127
text: A coconut bobbed past, in no hurry at all.

name: 6a036f74d4ff718b
text: "Some of us cross whole oceans," said the coconut.

name: 731699adf7a83456
text: "Our shells float."

name: 2dd1e9d840c1fb87
text: The river curved past a muddy bank and a sunny meadow.

name: 7d52b11099fc0198
text: Tuft had to find soil, water and light to grow.

name: a6dba009ae5ecd9a
text: It was a small place, but rain trickled in, and the sun warmed it every morning.

name: a7fec44e9636a861
text: Tuft put down one tiny root, then another.

name: 4bd837fe4265cd8f
text: Slowly a green shoot pushed out of the crack.

name: 85c920508c834cb9
text: People walked past and smiled.

name: f0d4bf7eaa447ec1
text: "Fancy growing there!" they said.

name: 0255f6c9b970d149
text: Tuft felt very proud.

name: 33687355da79e519
text: The Brave Little Flower

name: 34fc45d97923bfed
text: Dandelion seeds ride the wind on tiny parachutes, and they can grow in very small spaces with soil, water and light.

name: 32901d7eea55e1e6
text: The meadow soil was soft and damp.

name: ed25f7489386abc2
text: Tuft's root reached down and a shoot reached up to the Sun.

name: 9f946041dc1ca720
text: Soon a yellow flower opened, and then a fluffy dandelion clock full of new seeds.

name: 85c5d2b6355357f4
text: "Your turn," said Tuft, as the wind began to blow.

name: 4f1b67d9c1c8e07e
text: A New Dandelion Clock

name: c1242fe743a7fe5c
text: Plants spread their seeds by wind, water and animals, so new plants have room to grow, and the cycle starts again.

name: 9884bdf2940c4fad
text: Warm air lifted Tuft higher and higher, over fields, roads and a whole town.

name: c29ddede66c38b5a
text: The parachute held steady for hours.

name: d4635e9805687ecb
text: At last, the wind dropped, and Tuft drifted down onto a far hillside, where no dandelion had ever grown.

name: 69d38b79e76daa18
text: Soon, one bright yellow flower opened all alone.

name: e31edd9770ed3932
text: It was the very first of many.

name: c55c9feb3a84f869
text: The Very First Flower

name: fa0746a6c590d009
text: Light seeds on parachutes can ride rising warm air for a long way, which is how plants reach brand new places.

name: 3a0fbd9a0ac76cf8
text: On Mars, a small robot called Rusty is exploring with two friends.

name: 55fe3f554857692e
text: After a big dust storm, the others have stopped moving.

name: ccfca5af04aa0a98
text: The red sky was clearing.

name: 269ebfd41e7747da
text: Rusty blinked its lights.

name: 775478a992e1e04d
text: "Dot?

name: 6a38bab93b47fb5e
text: Dash?

name: de5faac816b82d60
text: Are you awake?"

name: cd59d5999c470a62
text: Its two robot friends stood silent, covered in red dust.

name: 378d69adf6dc48c3
text: Rusty checked its own battery: one quarter full.

name: b25dd36ef623eeb4
text: Far off, a thin swirl of wind was dancing across the sand.

name: f3bc60220012341d
text: The swirl was a dust devil, a spinning column of air.

name: 6bbead3ac5d84e1f
text: Rusty calculated its path.

name: d2f11eb4e6773dfb
text: "Warm air is rising and spinning," it said.

name: efde59fd460e9cc6
text: "It may sweep the dust away for us!"

name: ac8ab8e24139ff82
text: Rusty could wait for it to pass, or start cleaning by hand.

name: 4b696306bdb7b037
text: Bit by bit, the panels shone blue again.

name: a9263800e48b6de1
text: Sunlight touched them.

name: 73f44a5efcf723e3
text: A tiny green light came on, then Dot beeped.

name: 7187944981eaf48b
text: "Hello, Rusty!"

name: 22fe5a86b9b2e69f
text: Now Dash needed help too.

name: e06909654c8069ec
text: It was a long way off, and the Sun would set soon.

name: 6fe3e0e573020861
text: Mars days are only a little longer than Earth days.

name: b079f782be357db7
text: The dust devil swept past, and the dust lifted off in a long red ribbon.

name: 951840b9e0c1415b
text: Dot and Dash woke up together, beeping happily.

name: 38a8089b9c635017
text: "Thanks, wind!" said Rusty.

name: ae29e4a168ff4c89
text: This has really helped robots on Mars.

name: d621ec8fc0016e99
text: Thanks, Wind!

name: 0d78417a96c70f0e
text: Dust devils are real on Mars.

name: 031635e5cf00e2e2
text: Scientists saw that wind sometimes cleaned the solar panels of real Mars rovers.

name: e6ea92b74ee0de49
text: Together, Rusty and Dot brushed Dash clean as the Sun sank in a soft blue glow.

name: 957e338a59765ecd
text: Dash beeped awake just in time.

name: 39766e1ff02caf7e
text: Three little robots stood side by side, watching a Martian sunset.

name: b68a54972e7daa2f
text: Yes, on Mars, sunsets really do look blue!

name: 646c4abaf0ee056e
text: The Blue Sunset

name: 65c8cb81a7ccdb21
text: Fine dust in the air of Mars scatters light, so its sunsets glow blue, unlike the red and orange sunsets on Earth.

name: 4fff7cd3ba4a3d23
text: Rusty shared its power with its friends through the cold night.

name: d225673b48678de9
text: In the morning, their panels drank in the sunlight, and soon everyone was awake.

name: cf0898f5fe4c1bff
text: "We run on sunshine," said Rusty, "and on each other."

name: 23552d7d71e1b6e1
text: The three friends rolled off to explore the next crater.

name: 3c6a8f83f1e1fe2a
text: Running on Sunshine

name: d8583c691386aaf4
text: Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity, and batteries store it for when the Sun is not shining.

name: 60a56b0bb96f751e
text: After a big storm at Ammonite Bay, a small piece of cliff has fallen on the beach.

name: 13b18c9edb3725f2
text: Milo the fossil hunter spots something curly in the stone.

name: 40a85c4da820376b
text: Let us find out what, and you decide what happens next.

name: e11659a4ea372b5a
text: Milo crouched by a fallen stone.

name: fa174b5eb075f407
text: A perfect spiral curled across it.

name: 2815f06f0c2f523f
text: "A fossil!"

name: c4ae6ba5af5d1f0f
text: Milo said.

name: 3b7c6033f3fa1d57
text: High up, the cliff showed stripes of grey and brown rock.

name: e75abb9c57f293b4
text: Along the beach walked Dr. Anning, the town fossil expert, with her little hammer and brush.

name: 3d757565f6319eb2
text: "That is an ammonite!" said Dr. Anning.

name: e21b86e45ca55870
text: "It was a sea creature with a spiral shell, and it lived about 190 million years ago."

name: 326e1f40b7ebb18f
text: Milo stared.

name: c7a385c5ac355b91
text: "But this is a cliff."

name: 1ccd5827c3c15e27
text: She smiled.

name: 29e155276bfc34e9
text: "Back then, this was the sea floor!"

name: a8a643d60774d038
text: She offered Milo a soft brush.

name: 231de18dac381d39
text: "Each stripe was once a layer of mud on the sea floor," said Milo, checking a notebook.

name: 13fa41cafd6b6d18
text: "New layers settle on top of old ones, so the lowest are the oldest."

name: b14fd871098c16e1
text: So walking along the cliff was like turning the pages of a book.

name: 894b75148c182d24
text: Which page first?

name: 49aee02d4cefe398
text: "When the animal died, its shell sank into the mud," said Dr. Anning.

name: 55dd10ce556bb82c
text: "More mud covered it, and over millions of years, the mud turned to rock, and minerals replaced the shell."

name: 8da59b64f90f4c14
text: Milo looked at the stone in amazement.

name: a55612fd2a77467b
text: Where should it go now?

name: b247db00c00e226d
text: Under the mud, tiny ridges appeared along the spiral.

name: 51ef5d96a3cfde8a
text: Dr. Anning held up a magnifying glass.

name: df5fcadfd2845934
text: "Wonderful!

name: 5ef4ceba021de837
text: Careful hands like yours are how we learn from fossils."

name: 0b042c277ba732c7
text: Milo wrote down the date and the place.

name: 9a28d35b5ea152af
text: "A good fossil hunter always records where it was found."

name: 5f3537a636664f69
text: Careful Hands

name: 70de359b09b57857
text: Fossil hunters clean fossils gently and record exactly where each was found, since the place tells us its age.

name: 9cf8af143efbeaf1
text: A week later, Milo's ammonite sat in a glass case, with a small card: "Found by Milo."

name: 3c2f31845dc6241e
text: Visitors peered in, and little children pressed their noses to the glass.

name: 27d988bed3f5ced5
text: "Now everyone can learn from it," Dr. Anning said.

name: 8cef068929d2c0a3
text: Found by Milo

name: 2205d6d4ae37ec1b
text: Fossils form when living things are buried and slowly turn to rock.

name: 312cb2ad821576f6
text: Museums keep them safe for everyone to study.

name: 55858d8506c55a9e
text: Milo drew the rock layers on the board.

name: 928a4d23ebfe7ad3
text: "The lowest layers are the oldest," Milo explained.

name: 24297c3e3e0e5f36
text: "So fossils tell us what lived, and when."

name: 203dcbe2e14279ae
text: The whole class wanted to go to the beach.

name: a29d1242fd9b8a5e
text: Soon, everyone was a fossil hunter!

name: 550a1cd98863f9f9
text: Pages of Rock

name: 48985f08ba297c64
text: Rock layers build up over time, so lower layers are usually older.

name: 1958880f378754c1
text: Fossils in them are like pages of Earth's history.

name: 08bd4e3cb3e0fe51
text: As summer ends, Orla the monarch butterfly feels a strange pull.

name: ee0875c273beaf0f
text: Something is telling her to fly south, thousands of kilometres, to a place she has never seen.

name: 0d537d2fd5577f4d
text: Let us go with her, and you decide what happens next.

name: ee3bc9e3b79bde95
text: The days were getting shorter, and the milkweed was fading.

name: 578bc4cd69a194e1
text: "Time to go," said an older monarch, opening orange wings.

name: 481b6745a6a96b2a
text: "But I have never been there," said Orla.

name: 28c1ddf36dea18d6
text: "How will I know the way?"

name: 04cc39440e11c2ba
text: Above them, the Sun shone bright.

name: dbcb14b71a306296
text: Other butterflies gathered in a tree.

name: f577703a1a9f6e0e
text: Orla found that if she kept the Sun in the right place, she was always heading south.

name: d0111fbcc804f4e6
text: "It is like a compass in my head," she said.

name: 15b0a54b1584bd19
text: By midday, warm air was rising from the hills.

name: 8618ea0484ee1d46
text: A cold wind was blowing near the lake below.

name: fdeaa06dfc12e8de
text: The branches were orange with butterflies, keeping each other warm through the cool night.

name: 5041e560f2ba6031
text: "Monarchs fly only by day," said a neighbour.

name: 6e259b1715b49389
text: "We rest together."

name: 6cfcb74dc5692b96
text: In the morning, some flew high on the warm air, and others went looking for flowers.

name: b0d6317597859def
text: Orla sipped nectar until she felt strong.

name: f472a5003f2ca314
text: "This is the fuel for the whole trip," said a bee.

name: 27919dd4625e0b9f
text: "Without flowers along the way, you could not fly so far."

name: 43d514262f85bc15
text: People had planted a garden just for butterflies.

name: 400ef52f2b83a12f
text: Orla could rest here, or press straight on.

name: c7458f6d0def53ea
text: Weeks later, tall fir trees appeared on the mountains of Mexico, and they were covered in orange wings.

name: 0187759a36d3d70b
text: Orla had arrived, a place she had never seen.

name: ac0ec39e934fa5fb
text: Millions of monarchs rested together in the cool, misty air, waiting for spring.

name: d3f2ce78bb5e43e8
text: The Mountain Forest

name: 14f6d29c6d7e2e1c
text: Monarch butterflies from North America fly thousands of kilometres to the same mountains, using the Sun to find the way.

name: 0117bec680ef8c2d
text: A family came out to count the butterflies, smiling at Orla from a safe distance.

name: 44a3ed951c39d6d6
text: "We planted milkweed and flowers to help you on your way," a child whispered.

name: 0fac7a93bc799d21
text: The next morning, Orla flew on, strong and rested.

name: ef06c202df56b093
text: Small gardens can help a huge journey.

name: db681ea2d945ef0f
text: The Garden Stop

name: cbf6bbedcf1017ae
text: Monarch caterpillars eat only milkweed, and adults need nectar, so planting wildflowers really helps them.

name: c6ab446ee2823f56
text: Orla stayed with the group, day after day, until they reached the misty mountains.

name: 98ea608fe21a800e
text: All winter they rested.

name: b48cd25c8c0bbce7
text: In spring, she flew north, laid her eggs on milkweed, and her caterpillars grew.

name: 63bc2df507b7a52d
text: It would be her great-grandchildren who finished the trip home, and they had never seen the way either.

name: e057bc44a956a6f8
text: The Family Journey

name: a16e8b81ea4f39bb
text: The trip north takes several generations of monarchs, so butterflies finish a journey that their great-grandparents began.

name: 972dd89537413173
text: This is an old story from the Akan people of Ghana, told our own way.

name: 91ef9ecd8d02439b
text: Kweku Ananse the spider was very clever, and he wanted to be the cleverest of all.

name: 4c0d4970b66e626b
text: You decide what he does next.

name: 8b95299d71104303
text: Long ago, Ananse gathered every bit of wisdom he could find and sealed it in a clay pot.

name: 12d56a0d6f4542b1
text: "Now I know everything," he said, "and I will not share it."

name: 2ac5e4d502434f20
text: His young son, Ntikuma, watched him.

name: 97619daca8447129
text: "Where will you hide it, Father?"

name: 1ceaecc3a8d64cdb
text: Ananse looked at the tallest tree in the village, and then at his own silky web.

name: 79ff10fdb5b07e17
text: With the big pot tied to his front, Ananse could not hold on to the trunk.

name: 090b5458fc4e0328
text: He slipped down again and again.

name: 6038229b3ab35b0f
text: Ntikuma called up, "Father, why not tie the pot on your back?"

name: 8a85f5fb18e6b37a
text: Ananse stopped.

name: 9c4867442fe5ecc0
text: His little son knew something he did not!

name: 9b062acd761f8d3d
text: Ananse spun thread after thread.

name: 45f8448e1ba431cf
text: Spider silk is very thin, but it is strong for its size.

name: 7191a3d53a983886
text: The web held the heavy pot, swaying gently in the breeze.

name: 3b6684116688570a
text: But anyone walking by could see it there!

name: a5a65753885b3996
text: "Hmm," said Ananse.

name: f56a9192ad55dfdc
text: "Perhaps the tree is better after all."

name: 87b1d9deb09e9b8f
text: "When the pot is on your front, it pulls you away from the tree," said Ntikuma.

name: 32d81c1f9b1e79ad
text: "On your back, it sits close to your middle, so you can balance and hold on."

name: 94798ebb5792a58b
text: The village children nodded.

name: 3df870283d50f859
text: That is why people often carry heavy loads on their backs or heads.

name: 95090498de63283c
text: With the pot on his back, Ananse climbed easily.

name: f6cd9897fcaf990f
text: Halfway up, he stopped and laughed.

name: 84c9c6f264948ecd
text: "I thought I had all the wisdom in the world," he said, "but my own son knew something I did not."

name: 81355f3fe48fe75b
text: The pot felt silly now.

name: 97de457de9b5596c
text: What should he do with it?

name: f4f0dbbae3f39ed3
text: The pot fell and cracked open, and the wisdom flew out on the wind, into every village and every home.

name: 194c6cb7fb8a7394
text: "That is fair," said Ntikuma.

name: 0ff0918039672ce9
text: "Now everybody has a little."

name: 8fa3a17d2928fe81
text: Ananse agreed, and from then on he listened to others, even the smallest.

name: 6ae7c0112788da7e
text: Wisdom for Everyone

name: 8a2787f4953b8291
text: Ananse stories come from the Akan people of Ghana.

name: 7deec9f3baef911e
text: This one explains why nobody has all the wisdom: we learn from each other.

name: aea012b2a75b86da
text: Ananse plucked a silk thread like a guitar string.

name: a43074ad3647c696
text: "So thin, but it holds a whole pot!" he said.

name: 45c655d891db710e
text: He decided the best treasure was not the pot at all.

name: 1f8ed21bce67aa34
text: It was knowing how to make something so strong.

name: 4298a91e6d7d42c9
text: He hung the pot where everyone could share it.

name: 9e5b70a08be0af35
text: Stronger Than It Looks

name: 08471eaafc80a1ec
text: Spider silk is very strong for how thin and light it is.

name: 9bebe8d46092e7d1
text: Scientists study it to help make strong new materials.

name: eaf90d22b12327d3
text: That evening, Ananse told the whole village what had happened, and they laughed until they cried.

name: 54b5430ec102ab06
text: The children told it to their children, and they told it to theirs.

name: ea08ce3c372e7ee2
text: That is how the story has reached you today.

name: ee1a68605977c7b5
text: The Story Spreads

name: c315dae78a5e47da
text: Folk tales like Ananse's were passed on aloud for hundreds of years, long before they were written down.

name: f7ce6688aaf9410a
text: Esi and her brother Kojo cannot wait to try the new slide at school.

name: 7960ab70bc997032
text: But something is wrong with it.

name: 961837d2d5cbea20
text: Help them work out what, and you decide what they try.

name: 7a967081ca420861
text: Esi sat at the top of the shiny new slide, feet first, and let go.

name: de8c4d7c3f0c142d
text: She moved a little, then stopped halfway.

name: dc577d4be86e6a9c
text: "It is the slowest slide ever!" she laughed.

name: 956bc41a47d77dbb
text: Kojo had a box of toy cars and a few flat boards.

name: edd02801344699f4
text: "Something is holding you back," he said.

name: 9ee3b2141b97fef6
text: The slide felt rough, like fine sandpaper.

name: b3fc93ad2eb1ee84
text: "Rough surfaces rub against things more," said Kojo.

name: 63fec8efa3ddc5d6
text: "That rubbing force is called friction, and it slows things down."

name: 1eb735e8e9ffb86c
text: The caretaker was painting the steps nearby.

name: 215856433e2767cb
text: Esi also spotted a smooth plastic mat.

name: 485c6a5b29b993f7
text: Kojo covered one board with carpet, left one bare wood, and covered one with shiny plastic.

name: f1e3bd9a0a4cba62
text: Three cars zoomed down.

name: 54ea08dc4f739873
text: The car on plastic won, and the car on carpet crawled.

name: e06bdad52b57a5d5
text: "Bumpy carpet grips the wheels," said Esi.

name: 90f16646a54b76e0
text: "Smooth plastic hardly grips at all."

name: 8311fb7af0d7608a
text: "I painted the steps with grippy paint, so nobody slips on the ladder," said Mr Mensah.

name: 320e271774c12e68
text: "Oh dear, some must have dripped onto the slide!"

name: e7789d7d8bc973df
text: He would clean it off tonight.

name: 2d08f51191c52b09
text: "So grip is good on steps, but not on slides," said Kojo.

name: a23862e74e8afbb7
text: Esi zoomed down, feet first, and landed laughing at the bottom.

name: e2755c3cbc079773
text: "Smooth surfaces have less friction," said Kojo, "so you slide faster."

name: 2fe9755eaafb9e8d
text: They took turns, one at a time, until the bell rang.

name: 7c7c0aa9546fd2eb
text: Friction is a force between two surfaces that rub.

name: a61ef46878de4262
text: Smooth surfaces make less friction, so things slide more easily.

name: c28415f844021e41
text: Esi looked at the bumpy soles of her trainers.

name: b4b1d2550b6266fb
text: "Friction stops me slipping when I run!"

name: 72df4644b4d57e84
text: Kojo squeezed the brakes on his bike, and the rubber pads gripped the wheel.

name: 68adda6c311a4d42
text: "And friction helps bikes stop," he said.

name: 9ff8718eb7c6ea57
text: Friction was not a problem.

name: 2b9c359da4b05139
text: It was a helper!

name: ef16689497e71c84
text: Grip Is Good

name: 4125dcdda43e6bde
text: Friction can be useful.

name: c8e63f41898c15fe
text: It lets shoes grip the ground and bike brakes slow the wheels.

name: bb5e977beadfd2d0
text: Kojo crumpled one sheet into a ball and kept the other flat.

name: a114a03980df905a
text: He dropped them together.

name: 27dd455b6b9473bd
text: The ball fell fast, but the flat sheet floated down slowly.

name: 09536925a49f0556
text: "The flat sheet pushes against more air," said Esi.

name: 2b135c04bd965534
text: "That is how parachutes work!"

name: 2e368664f04b67d1
text: The Paper Parachute

name: 3feb56d667237e06
text: Air resistance pushes against things moving through the air.

name: 79f855ff4106e8a0
text: A wide shape catches more air, so it falls more slowly.

name: 189e1e17d5f12475
text: Benny the beaver loves building things.

name: b7447f4d5bb709f4
text: Tomorrow is the big riverside picnic, and the sky looks grey.

name: 655fb6ccc318a200
text: Help Benny choose the right materials, and you decide what he tries.

name: aaa4982d02b40d8a
text: Plip, plop!

name: d3bac801068a8114
text: Rain began to fall on Benny's workbench.

name: 327302d74046f570
text: "I need an umbrella for the picnic," he said, "but what should I make it from?"

name: 0d47f6cb35bd6cec
text: On the bench lay paper, a cotton cloth, a plastic sheet and some kitchen foil.

name: 77d51cf60f12718b
text: His friends' things were piled by the door.

name: 75a7a0340843c970
text: The paper went soggy and tore.

name: 51070d5e8bdc3cb2
text: Drips crept through the cotton cloth.

name: 61953daeb0572c7e
text: But under the plastic sheet and the foil, everything stayed dry.

name: 6abce49a1b8bf57a
text: "These are waterproof," said Benny.

name: 3fd0942c053e6e68
text: "Water cannot get through them."

name: 2fb134937ccf586c
text: He wished he could see the sky through them too.

name: c7d7324b48ea96cd
text: A spoon of metal.

name: 2d750d431ef9efd7
text: A chair of wood.

name: a578b6f994314b41
text: A jumper of wool.

name: 4bcec8e61b318b9d
text: A window of glass.

name: 493ce236690751e6
text: "Every object is made of a material," said Benny, "and we choose materials for what they can do."

name: 1b82a2abc65c9e7f
text: Glass lets light in, and wood is strong.

name: 66587eceff4d29de
text: Then a drip landed on his nose.

name: 5b6af11724c98d23
text: The roof leaked!

name: 9d4e5442d3c3db27
text: Benny could see straight through the glass.

name: ab24044a3fb1a2e9
text: Through frosted plastic, he saw only blurry shapes.

name: 36409e58947ccea7
text: Through wood and foil, he saw nothing at all.

name: bf5f397f79b4f172
text: "Clear, blurry and blocked!" he said.

name: 26975f93916fe2d0
text: In his box was some old clear plastic from a broken toy.

name: d499ac31bd73674e
text: At the picnic, the rain pattered down, but everyone under Benny's umbrella stayed snug and dry.

name: c8c63db54388715e
text: "Good choice!" said his friends, passing round the berries.

name: b3f3411c5ad50c31
text: The Dry Picnic

name: 51a56148aee71ae2
text: Waterproof materials, like plastic, do not let water through.

name: 8f78f466205d6a41
text: That makes them good for umbrellas and raincoats.

name: 2674691d17e9b711
text: Under the clear umbrella, Benny stayed dry and watched every raindrop splash above him.

name: 6f9cc7e5a985c77e
text: Then the sun came out, and a rainbow appeared right through the plastic!

name: 59913a6f4b6a18d7
text: Watching the Rain

name: 85c74ce4b1959c51
text: Transparent materials let light through clearly.

name: bba915e84d3a4538
text: Translucent ones let some through, and opaque ones let none through.

name: b1b1bd1429e13bd6
text: Benny made his umbrella from old plastic scraps, sewn together like a patchwork quilt.

name: ff23e392a89bd0e2
text: "This plastic would have lasted for ages in the river," he said.

name: e2c4423f5134914e
text: "Now it keeps us dry instead!"

name: a9df2518066df602
text: A Second Life

name: fc5725698448317a
text: Plastic lasts a very long time, so reusing and recycling it helps keep it out of rivers and seas.

name: 6d6847965a173bb1
text: Mo the mole lives under a vegetable garden.

name: 2bcd9b6c4f4f7629
text: One corner is a muddy puddle, and another is dry as dust.

name: fbd6950dccd304ff
text: Help Mo find out why, and you decide where to dig.

name: 023783a5397a337e
text: After the rain, the carrots in one corner sat in a muddy puddle.

name: 49624d46dfe79fc5
text: Across the garden, the beans looked dry and thirsty.

name: fdc5e4553f5f5c53
text: Mo poked his nose out of a molehill.

name: cc6870819a97e326
text: "Same rain, but different ground," he said.

name: 82d589b90bdf4095
text: "I wonder what is under there."

name: 8ff04de69804685b
text: Near the top, the soil was dark and crumbly, full of bits of old leaves.

name: e5790ebe2630b1a7
text: Lower down, under the soggy corner, it was sticky, smooth clay.

name: 27c9a9e847640f87
text: Under the dry corner it was gritty sand.

name: 13ef70ee26452e8e
text: Deeper still, Mo's paws hit solid rock.

name: 02880659e1e162bb
text: Mo poured the same amount of water into three pots.

name: 7eaebdc9a815e19b
text: Through the sand, it ran out in a rush.

name: c1ca96dbabf2a4a5
text: The clay held on to it, and hardly any dripped through.

name: 80baf29f100acb08
text: The dark, crumbly soil let some through and kept some.

name: 949171306ea4c36b
text: A worm wriggled out of the last pot.

name: 6127b259173f4a2b
text: One rock sparkled with tiny crystals.

name: 818e18576f830e36
text: "Granite," said Mo.

name: 80340851be8d58be
text: "It formed when melted rock cooled down slowly, deep underground."

name: 21a011b3dcb41ab8
text: Another had stripes, like a layer cake.

name: cea86a1f8dcdd578
text: "Sandstone, made of sand pressed together over a very long time."

name: 855ef186814ef0df
text: Little grains crumbled from its edges.

name: 29d8c8669acfc9d3
text: "We make tunnels," said the worm, "so air and water can get into the soil.

name: d6c708fbaa00fa5e
text: And we pull down dead leaves and turn them into rich soil."

name: b77a4f4ec396a9d7
text: Mo made sure to leave the worms in peace from then on.

name: f0011d071a820e3a
text: The Worm Helpers

name: 22e8eae851c299a9
text: Earthworms make tunnels that let air and water into soil, and they help turn dead leaves into rich new soil.

name: a390795295793045
text: A few grains of sand fell off the sandstone.

name: cae0097118403a71
text: "Rain, wind, ice and roots break rock into tiny bits," said Mo.

name: 9ea3da2d75d95e5d
text: "Mixed with rotted leaves, those bits become soil."

name: dfa050aefdace641
text: It takes a very long time, so every handful of soil is old and precious.

name: 5dbffac36bd48a7a
text: From Rock to Soil

name: 46b7948e7b1e1980
text: Soil is made of tiny bits of broken rock mixed with rotted plants and animals.

name: aff503a9eb1a78ee
text: Rocks break down very slowly.

name: a00c57300034607f
text: Long before maps and compasses, Pacific Islanders sailed great canoes across thousands of kilometres of ocean.

name: 2a17d416aa6f2bcb
text: Kai is on her first voyage with her grandmother, a master navigator.

name: 9f2422a7de833ca0
text: You decide what Kai learns first.

name: 31afa5ed6ce9ab88
text: The big double canoe glided through the dark.

name: e53feb12a0995426
text: There was no map and no compass on board.

name: 1257fe9d0647f0b6
text: "How do we know the way, Grandmother Mele?" asked Kai, staying close by her side as the crew had taught her.

name: 7722936e8cabbf65
text: Grandmother pointed at the stars, and then down at the rolling waves.

name: 63aba27b00c07d39
text: "Each star rises in the same place on the edge of the sea, every night," said Grandmother Mele.

name: 33bae33dbe3bda0f
text: "And it sets in the same place too.

name: 69ec948e1b73cddc
text: If you know where your star rises, you know which way to steer."

name: 9f2a730598676266
text: Kai picked out a bright star low in the east.

name: cf85bddb00e7ee8e
text: Long, smooth swells rolled under the canoe, one after another, all from the same direction.

name: 8d3b1b6c6d7d2409
text: "Those swells were made by winds far away," said Grandmother.

name: 388ba4f5b6095f0d
text: "They keep coming the same way for days.

name: fe13a85e795055f4
text: Feel how they lift the canoe, and you can hold your course."

name: b04b7d1df03c8dde
text: At dawn, white sea birds flew past, out to sea to catch fish.

name: e63b4c9ca96c3117
text: "Watch them again at sunset," said Grandmother.

name: 6ab465f8370b1386
text: "Some birds fly home to land each evening."

name: d600c1ee5072ee23
text: All day, Kai watched.

name: 9d1c14950745406b
text: A fluffy cloud sat still on the horizon while others drifted by.

name: 1908e0e7c36a1398
text: Star after star rose from the same places, night after night, and Kai learned their names.

name: faaf82fd22fb3a4a
text: On the tenth morning, a green island rose from the sea, right where Grandmother said it would be.

name: 9232b1c8cc31fe63
text: The Star Path

name: d9bf69fdd88c597c
text: Stars rise and set at the same places on the horizon each night, so Pacific navigators used them like a compass.

name: 238f56becf075221
text: Even on cloudy nights with no stars, Kai could feel the swells and keep the canoe on course.

name: a46100234ef14b82
text: "You have the navigator's gift," smiled Grandmother Mele.

name: ca4cf04c927a61bd
text: Steering by Feel

name: e5bfaecb9036a792
text: Ocean swells can travel thousands of kilometres in the same direction, so navigators could steer by feeling them.

name: 48d9d9b4c5403c3a
text: The birds flew straight towards the still cloud.

name: 771ba97c15675c6b
text: Below it, a green island appeared, with a sandy beach.

name: 9b2899da3fcb586f
text: "Clouds often pile up over islands," said Grandmother, "and the birds always know the way home."

name: 63cd15385ddd6b8d
text: The crew cheered.

name: 8f1d2b3e09eee2a0
text: Land Ho!

name: 16e5007a66857d2c
text: Some sea birds fish far out at sea and fly back to land at dusk, so navigators watched them to find islands.

name: 28bdba41d6305f6e
text: In a forest in Ghana, the moon is rising, and Adwoa the pangolin is waking up.

name: 910e495fc4b4fd15
text: Pangolins come out at night.

name: 515da28580d5e0c7
text: She is hungry!

name: ae60a705f1c86671
text: You decide where she goes.

name: 647983d20be84bc6
text: Adwoa stretched, and her scales clicked softly, like a coat of armour.

name: 8ef0f05b98e43165
text: Her eyes were small, but her nose was amazing.

name: 5fab2c8fd4d2273a
text: "Ants and termites," she sniffed.

name: 0a7dd73363096478
text: "Somewhere close."

name: 9689324413db0ea6
text: Above her, a tall tree creaked.

name: 885bb27a4f5304e5
text: Below, the forest floor was full of smells.

name: d3f0f838e444b60c
text: The smell led to a termite mound, tall and hard as baked clay.

name: fc8aef01b0f64e7e
text: Adwoa's front claws were long and strong, perfect for digging.

name: ea3ee4f253836bf8
text: Then she heard leaves rustling.

name: 4e8ec7ca17ccf5e7
text: Something big was coming along the path!

name: 872811953e839cb6
text: Adwoa's tail gripped the branches like an extra hand.

name: 65741535bc98c3d8
text: High up, tree ants had made a nest of leaves.

name: 623c7da4c9536e0a
text: "Supper!" she said.

name: 92d5e9efc27d46a4
text: From up here, she could also smell a termite mound down on the ground.

name: a81693340c3a17c7
text: Adwoa rolled into a tight ball.

name: b195b83237865d1b
text: Her hard scales covered her soft belly.

name: 6b34284b2cd6d38d
text: A big, snuffling bush pig trotted past, sniffed the scaly ball, and wandered off.

name: 50924bdd47fffcd4
text: It was only looking for fallen fruit!

name: 7fdcb77120067a56
text: Soon all was quiet again.

name: 6e23d7254618bbba
text: Holding on with her tail, Adwoa licked up the tree ants.

name: a51d803671642559
text: Then she curled up in a hollow branch to sleep away the day, high above the forest floor.

name: 62f0b2a565c47943
text: Supper in the Trees

name: 5813d84f870ec868
text: Some pangolins live in trees and hold on with their tails.

name: 1490c56b738d0a0c
text: Each animal has body parts suited to where it lives.

name: 5183bbc0d1c1b68a
text: Adwoa curled up in the burrow, snug in her scales, and slept until the moon rose again.

name: 7020f6a1fac34232
text: Tomorrow night, the termites would still be there.

name: a3469917d38613fe
text: Safe and Snug

name: 3d39e3b2d603187b
text: A pangolin's scales are made of keratin, like your fingernails.

name: 7b43c7fa6659f0cd
text: Curling into a ball protects its soft belly.

name: ca6bbe30f22170d2
text: At Polar Star Research Station, the radio is crackling!

name: d9d5a1b5763447c8
text: A weather balloon is sending a message, but it arrives scrambled.

name: a319443f42d135b0
text: The scientists need a sharp pattern-spotter.

name: 3095bf755ac9fedb
text: Ready to decode it?

name: e7e8b77dc5765a5b
text: Restore the balloon's message, one puzzle at a time.

name: b552baf108740147
text: The signal repeats a pattern: beep, beep, boop, beep, beep, boop, beep, beep, ...

name: 8d14a435dde18472
text: The signal repeats the group "beep, beep, boop".

name: cd2ff2ba4bef0807
text: After two beeps always comes a boop.

name: b59cdaba30d111cf
text: The pattern is beep, beep, boop, again and again.

name: 3e8fb047839ae180
text: The balloon sends height readings: 3, 6, 12, 24, ...

name: f86eee67e777e797
text: What number comes next?

name: 75df2b2710dc419d
text: Each reading doubles: 3, 6, 12, 24, so the next is 24 times 2, which is 48.

name: f2c6e12e241bc223
text: Check a rule on every step, not just one.

name: abed4b7abe3b4610
text: Correct!

name: 6f17636860304e9c
text: Each number is double the one before.

name: adc7678a16a11d78
text: Four words arrived out of order.

name: b5f213331345eb97
text: Use the clues to put them in the right order.

name: 9429b14e36b4d776
text: "Balloon" has the capital, "is" comes next, and "safely" is last, so "landing" fills the gap: Balloon is landing safely.

name: 4f6189d893ea88be
text: The last word is in a shift code: each letter was moved one step forward in the alphabet.

name: d3fa37a7a3e922d4
text: The code word is IPNF.

name: ef65de0d8f8e7d97
text: What does it say?

name: b2ffc04fbbd12981
text: Moving each letter of IPNF one step back gives H, O, M, E: HOME.

name: b8ad94089363596c
text: Cracked it!

name: 9aca39df8dd83821
text: I to H, P to O, N to M, F to E.

name: 8059d90f94e82d24
text: At Maple Street School, the class drew a chalk circle around a big puddle on Monday.

name: 3c9acebb9d8175d1
text: By Wednesday, the puddle had vanished!

name: 0f6a3964130efdac
text: Nobody saw it go.

name: 2075bd2f52788a5b
text: Where did all that water disappear to?

name: 58ce3e0b95197f5c
text: Work out where the puddle went.

name: 5878323538f26686
text: What most likely happened to the puddle?

name: 43511bb15a6f4f89
text: Warmth, moving air and a wide surface all speed up evaporation.

name: ec90b92ce9719cab
text: That is why towels dry best on a warm, windy day.

name: 1de7f51180668586
text: Put the journey of the water in order, from puddle to puddle.

name: 44e1ab049a828309
text: This is the water cycle.

name: a38d2f65f5c1498e
text: The same water goes round and round, so the water in that puddle is very, very old!

name: 80d8891a0d0b74ca
text: The class wants to prove that sun dries water faster.

name: 25467c9620bac90d
text: Which test is fair?

name: ea36a5e27707fd2d
text: In a fair test, you change one thing and keep everything else the same.

name: 47ed91e3ca461331
text: Then you know what caused the result.

name: 1a6177bc1616d2d2
text: Only one thing is different, so it is a fair test.

name: 91b1c6cffeb7edb9
text: The little lighthouse at Pebble Bay has gone dark!

name: a842074649dcf4c2
text: All the boats are safely in the harbour, but Keeper Mina needs the lamp back by tonight.

name: 26ae6379221b2784
text: Grab your notebook and help her find the fault.

name: 41b0dc4e14682767
text: Find out why the lamp stopped, and how to mend it.

name: 41076fb624255d35
text: What is the most likely problem?

name: 6a0751cd415306df
text: The bulb and battery both work.

name: 4f5e58df188d5312
text: That leaves the wires, and one gap stops electricity going all the way around.

name: 3594fd8db153672a
text: With a good bulb and battery, the loop must be broken.

name: d97cef31aa3f0b3f
text: Where is the gap in the wire?

name: 5b720fd154da8b3f
text: Electricity reaches point 2 but not point 3, so the gap must be between them.

name: d8d3c895b49421c8
text: Testing step by step narrows a problem down.

name: fa4fe5eb6b7f84f7
text: Well traced!

name: 08567ff206cfb056
text: It reaches point 2, but not point 3.

name: 87bb6cc5f07168dc
text: Which materials would let electricity flow?

name: 0291a5bfeaad333d
text: Copper, aluminium and steel are metals, so they conduct.

name: 84bf0ed79ef625ed
text: Rubber and wood are insulators, which is why wires have rubbery coats.

name: dfd923b44464bccd
text: Keeper Mina is a trained grown-up.

name: 247e39e6f9a35c9e
text: Put her repair steps in order.

name: 4b26f371fdafba89
text: Power goes off first and on again last.

name: 948daaafb56ab934
text: Never touch real electrics yourself: this job is for trained grown-ups.

name: d93194904d295ce5
text: Space explorer Captain Zuri is on a grand tour, and sends postcards to the Star School.

name: 3f0f1bd4df7856bf
text: But she forgot to write where she is!

name: 4dfef41576818306
text: Can you work out which planets she has visited?

name: c71621072da7c14e
text: Name each place from the clues on the postcards.

name: ee543bee23b8e304
text: Where was the first postcard written?

name: 284dc4dda2fd5aeb
text: Mars gets its red colour from rusty dust.

name: 119191c34cced816
text: Its two small moons are called Phobos and Deimos.

name: a25bc8976a078240
text: Mars is red, has two moons, and a similar day.

name: 9a794ed140d7313a
text: Where was the second postcard written?

name: 81f284d839b568d1
text: Jupiter is the largest planet.

name: b4f976f83ddd4075
text: Its Great Red Spot is a giant storm that has lasted for hundreds of years.

name: 79878511d61d6e66
text: Jupiter is the biggest, with its Great Red Spot.

name: cb7c9eb8649db4e7
text: Zuri says she saw rings on the way home.

name: 1a03eaf647ba5897
text: Which planets have rings?

name: 823e76253ceeddc2
text: All four giant planets have rings, made of ice, rock and dust.

name: 6cf972ede48a1a47
text: Saturn's are simply the brightest.

name: e99a307ee5f389ce
text: Zuri flies from the Sun outwards.

name: 6d466d06ac66ecc9
text: Put these planets in the order she passes them.

name: 306603ccc00cb3da
text: Going out from the Sun, the order is Venus, Earth, Mars and then Jupiter.

name: 404e255da63ded3d
text: Mercury is closer in, and the other giants are further out.

name: 94bc2aa4e135484d
text: At sunrise on Coral Beach, Ranger Tala found strange tracks leading up from the sea to the dunes and back again.

name: 09d97175d4499088
text: Nobody saw who made them.

name: 8091fe205b408e52
text: Bring your magnifying glass!
