name: cd4b8646b8ec7323
text: Find out who made the tracks, and why.

name: 49d73ce5a2b3e2b9
text: Which animal made the tracks?

name: 964d827fbc8d122d
text: Sea turtles pull themselves up the beach with their flippers, and their heavy shell leaves a groove in the sand.

name: 3eb2637da98deabc
text: Flippers and a heavy shell leave tracks like these.

name: d039a81c91f76dc0
text: Why did the turtle come ashore?

name: b15423e5a82211d9
text: Female sea turtles come ashore to dig a nest, lay their eggs and cover them with sand.

name: 8c98ed98a0a1efdf
text: Then they return to the sea.

name: 08211f3a1bff9ba2
text: The dug sand and the ranger's guide both show that.

name: e4c1388838c01e50
text: When did the turtle cross the beach?

name: 6bfc042f398f50f9
text: The waves smooth the sand at high tide, so tracks that survive must be newer than 10 pm.

name: 883d4ff290278d36
text: Using time like this is good detective work.

name: 93862d6c18ced94c
text: Tracks made before high tide would have been washed.

name: c81afac91ebaf7af
text: How can we help protect the nest?

name: 0f5a0f30bfa9738c
text: The best help is to leave the nest alone, mark it, and keep the beach dark, so the hatchlings can reach the sea.

name: f2993c0ea289a6f6
text: Baker Bo's bakery is famous for tall, fluffy loaves.

name: 687d642321eb2eef
text: But today every loaf came out flat as a plate!

name: 9889d39f397b7097
text: The recipe has not changed.

name: 87f4eb47bed92f1e
text: Put on your apron and help find out what went wrong.

name: fc10edaa24722c90
text: Find out why the bread didn't rise.

name: 3fd035d1be5ed7f3
text: Yeast is a tiny living thing.

name: 6d9ea56ddeea728e
text: What does it need to work?

name: 767590c8c2a0d64f
text: Yeast is a tiny living fungus.

name: 4a003ba3cdce4c38
text: With water, food and warmth, it becomes busy and starts to make gas.

name: 56e1eab0f82dbcb8
text: What changed between the good loaves and the flat ones?

name: 27da9ac8f323bbc9
text: Everything matched except where the dough rested.

name: 0797f5196def42c0
text: Comparing two days like this is a fair test.

name: 87c5df12bddd31cf
text: The place it rested is the only difference.

name: cb075920230f974b
text: Put the steps in order to show how yeast makes bread rise.

name: 0310431ddf0ef79e
text: The gas is carbon dioxide.

name: 14d6df01a2d20c60
text: Those are the little holes you see when you slice a loaf of bread!

name: b1ddd3369734441f
text: What should Baker Bo do tomorrow?

name: 01689847d83c9c0e
text: Resting the dough somewhere warm lets the yeast make plenty of gas, and the loaves rise tall again.

name: e87ef5683c76f5e4
text: Warm dough is what worked well on Monday.

name: 170f385d8ab2b760
text: Farmer Lin has three rows of apple trees.

name: 2704ff2d27b70ee5
text: Rows A and B are heavy with apples, but Row C has hardly any!

name: ab176e64333c26f1
text: The trees look healthy, and the flowers were beautiful in spring.

name: 3936b852977968a1
text: What is going on?

name: 4a265a0cfa72a813
text: Find out why Row C grew so few apples.

name: 80d81ea55a2f6e29
text: First, how does a flower become an apple?

name: 26a5ff3dca0c481d
text: Put the steps in order.

name: f7250f20a5d29adb
text: This is called pollination.

name: 02db6cf761cfdc9c
text: The bee gets a meal of nectar, and the flower gets the pollen it needs.

name: 873d830bdf5dc795
text: Which clue best explains Row C?

name: 805bae3ed409141b
text: Trees, sun, soil and water are all the same.

name: 6a10c6b466b3a163
text: The big difference is the number of bees.

name: 75dfe88673689f7b
text: With so few bees, little pollen was carried there.

name: fa0d901b6405f6e8
text: Why did so few bees visit Row C?

name: d3c4b90228d8a890
text: Moving the hive put Row C far from the bees, so most of them stopped visiting it.

name: cb0d4589d62a4bfa
text: One small change can make a big difference.

name: cdd932aa6d052dc1
text: The bees stayed close to their new home.

name: 0f1c30a0e93ce83f
text: How can Farmer Lin bring the bees back?

name: 7cd4bc0caaf1fdf5
text: A nearby hive, plenty of flowers and no harmful sprays make the orchard a good place for bees, and for apples too.

name: d6fe3581f4f19879
text: C: Seven.

name: b2fd69ae8db13a4b
text: Mars looks red because its dust has lots of iron in it, a bit like rust.

name: ec323d70e2dc3a67
text: The answer is Mars.

name: ab2e831968fcf9b0
text: Which is the biggest planet in our Solar System?

name: 867c943c8e1f5978
text: Jupiter is the biggest planet.

name: 05e254c8def7940e
text: More than a thousand Earths could fit inside it.

name: d6c52ec817edc4eb
text: The answer is Jupiter.

name: 1ea0be51f846047c
text: D: Mercury.

name: 57d33224bf268709
text: Which planet is famous for its huge, bright rings?

name: 3075733fb8c2f352
text: Saturn's rings are made of countless pieces of ice and rock.

name: e8b359bc12eb4ed9
text: The answer is Saturn.

name: c1f49aff5f1603c3
text: About how long does Earth take to travel once around the Sun?

name: e170aa98f53fc004
text: One trip around the Sun takes about 365 days.

name: fe279ed6a66507fd
text: That is what a year is!

name: 3c4cf0d8b475d617
text: The answer is One year.

name: 220aa5c4dd84a1d1
text: In which year did people first walk on the Moon?

name: 5cb543db847b622b
text: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the Moon in 1969.

name: ab506ef864b637ad
text: The answer is 1969.

name: ada18dd8c0d7dcf2
text: Which planet is closest to the Sun?

name: a481e445bb1ee4ec
text: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun, and also the smallest planet.

name: 809e2605d804aaa3
text: The answer is Mercury.

name: 3064cfc093dd3155
text: Which planet is the hottest?

name: 1154b29f21cd9199
text: Venus is hotter than Mercury, even though it is farther from the Sun.

name: 4d0ea359a9948c37
text: Its thick clouds trap the heat like a blanket.

name: dd29b2d041ddd42b
text: The answer is Venus.

name: 1b8a636764c1cf48
text: What do scientists call Pluto now?

name: b75e38970fd61a12
text: In 2006, scientists renamed Pluto a dwarf planet.

name: 86a1c2508cd059a0
text: It is even smaller than our Moon.

name: 8b7317ad53492b39
text: The answer is A dwarf planet.

name: 60cade3e63ddbd49
text: About how long does sunlight take to reach Earth?

name: 24d451a736444bd4
text: The Sun is about 150 million kilometres away, so its light takes about 8 minutes to reach us.

name: b0136050f1398d3c
text: The answer is About 8 minutes.

name: 470d071e66cb968e
text: What is a black hole?

name: 9dfd95755e776287
text: A black hole squeezes so much stuff into a small space that its gravity pulls in everything nearby, even light.

name: dd9856969fa6cb2d
text: The answer is A place where gravity traps even light.

name: f64a061ba8877160
text: What is the biggest animal known to have ever lived?

name: c979fa595d41a165
text: The blue whale is the biggest animal known to have ever lived, even bigger than the largest dinosaurs.

name: 66abb2be59bc7568
text: The answer is The blue whale.

name: 902c2d13a1e2c755
text: Which animal is the tallest?

name: 8e22b8c18664f2b1
text: Giraffes are the tallest animals.

name: ff5d1925fab133c0
text: Their long necks help them reach leaves high up in trees.

name: bbdb71582d91658d
text: The answer is The giraffe.

name: 2ce75d8246c2c645
text: How many legs does a spider have?

name: c4581d6d905fa45f
text: Spiders have eight legs.

name: 577184ae60d99fe7
text: Insects, like ants and bees, have six.

name: 9b1098a4ede7e689
text: What do honeybees make?

name: 4e5b5ecb158efae7

name: fc108f3e771939c0
text: B: Water carries sound very well.

name: 5cf280fe7f2fbcc3
text: C: Waves carry the words.

name: 65b16fa8dfd490eb
text: C: Water carries sound very well.

name: b915e5014ebf9f78
text: B: Waves carry the words.

name: aa696213c3d2d5a2
text: A: Their eyes cannot move.

name: b075f622ba08f6d4
text: D: To scare mice.

name: 0f730dfe6e2cbe78
text: A: To dry their feathers.

name: 938399870950e602
text: B: To scare mice.

name: b087f39ea5efb381
text: C: It is lighter in colour.

name: 4264e774d00f2521
text: D: It is pulled up by the Sun.

name: 7afb4c71de8ce427
text: B: It is pulled up by the Sun.

name: f6360a358edcaaed
text: C: It is less dense than water.

name: 9dd9e2b0cfc2a88c
text: Right!

name: c40e26bb5a8902d8
text: The Rainbow Mist, from The Forest That Forgot Its Colours.

name: 0b5e9a4dc2714867
text: The robot stopped before the flag.

name: 5477938f60aa9321
text: Add more steps!

name: 99b10fc639990c0d
text: This is how I sound now.

name: 7bad03c84ef16007
text: You earned a star!

name: 674226a80b39613e
text: Wings!

name: 1b08afc48bc76832
text: Wow, this picture is full of lines!

name: a6f415e7571f39c0
text: Save it, or start over.

name: 4c6039afdc973940
text: Yes! bird.

name: a6bcc98bb4b3d7e7
text: Yes! frog.

name: fea7f3fece311e4e
text: Yes! moon.

name: f0e5a28bb82e4bc2
text: Yes! seed.

name: 4e949272c9690ba4
text: You found Ankylosaurus!

name: 046cff44f6575eeb
text: You found Triceratops!

name: a049b75bc4c82147
text: You found Tyrannosaurus!

name: 80b565520d83ffd7
text: You can type a question, or tap one of the ideas.

name: e008f30df2c0e0ca
text: I know about animals, space, weather, nature, your body and science.

name: 3824d36f89e5e814
text: I can tell jokes, too!

name: 3a5b6f15d7ec05ac
text: And I can take you to missions and stories!

name: bce73b53f1139cf3
text: Hi there!

name: 21f3178c2e5cb182
text: What would you like to discover today?

name: da0f7dbf9fce91b6
text: Hello again!

name: b1ff439bb93cbce2
text: Ask me anything about animals, space or nature.

name: 931a8c0ae8ff658b
text: You're welcome!

name: c8f3337f9ed6492d
text: Want to discover something else?

name: 735c9cfc508a28ec
text: Stories are great!

name: 6057999046e4610c
text: In Living Stories, you choose what happens next, and every choice leads somewhere different.

name: 55d9b049044398d1
text: I will read it to you.

name: af17dcce9bb69f9f
text: At sunset, sunlight travels through much more air to reach you.

name: 024c115f51e1cab5
text: Most of the blue light gets scattered away on the trip.

name: 2d20a31d440e457f
text: The reds and oranges make it through!

name: b41bffe63a826987
text: A rainbow appears when sunlight shines through raindrops.

name: 2fad51f8f95f5256
text: Each drop bends the light and splits it into colours.

name: eb62812103894cc8
text: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet!

name: a43e3b25ec7e49ba
text: Stars twinkle because their light passes through moving air.

name: 7b03344850c92000
text: The air bends the light a tiny bit, again and again.

name: 740efe97dccd00ac
text: Out in space, stars would not twinkle at all!

name: 9b2c9b655c2e5cd9
text: Earth is tilted, like a spinning top that's leaning over.

name: 4a43f5d825c8e1d6
text: When it leans away, it is winter!

name: 33ce01cb92adbacf
text: Rain slowly wears away rocks and carries tiny bits of salt into rivers.

name: fd82e9cda3466ceb
text: Rivers carry that salt to the sea.

name: 35c362440dee862f
text: Over millions of years, the ocean became salty!

name: df04d795322a31b7
text: Leaves are green because of a helper called chlorophyll.

name: 6c852f74a9357ff9
text: In autumn, trees stop making it.

name: 8a92ee0ed008f8f3
text: Then the yellows and oranges hiding underneath can show!

name: c0727c76dc459879
text: Kente is a famous, colourful cloth from Ghana, first woven by the Asante and Ewe peoples.

name: ed2fa011d60a010d
text: Weavers make long, narrow strips on a loom, then sew them together.

name: e6c203008f636853
text: Each colour has a meaning, like gold for wealth and green for growth.

name: 2266dff7cad3dfa8
text: Adinkra are symbols from Ghana, made by the Akan people, and each one has a meaning.

name: c16e925133bd013a
text: Sankofa is a bird looking back over its shoulder.

name: c5d02acf6a60e7dc
text: It means: learn from the past to build the future.

name: 8c75ca4d142638c9
text: In Ghana and other parts of West Africa, drummers can make drums talk!

name: 4182b8b3acf0d72c
text: Languages like Twi go up and down in tone.

name: f6905a262ca76332
text: The drums copy those ups and downs, so they can send names and messages.

name: ff6a52219ef5e606
text: Kwaku Ananse is a clever spider from Ghanaian folk tales, first told by the Akan people.

name: c1dc6df63be3cdb5
text: He often uses tricks to win.

name: e7146009b1106b77
text: In one tale, he wins all the stories in the world.

name: 376b694dba0eeb73
text: That is why Akan folk tales are called Anansesem, spider stories!

name: 8712c5621b2726f3
text: The Harmattan is a dry, dusty wind.

name: fa2b6c8f7a141870
text: It blows from the Sahara Desert across West Africa, from about November to March.

name: 89a329889c3a3a3a
text: It can make the sky hazy, the mornings cool, and lips and skin dry!

name: 6c529a3a8ecb57c8
text: Mole National Park is Ghana's biggest wildlife park.

name: be8d861c1c15e722
text: Elephants, antelopes, warthogs and baboons live there.

name: 7c6f24d9da53059c
text: Visitors can watch elephants come to drink at the waterholes.

name: c1fa5737fcd3a4cf
text: Ghana is a country in West Africa, and its capital city is Accra.

name: 440a0cfed3d9ef1e
text: In 1957, led by Kwame Nkrumah, Ghana became one of the first African countries to win independence.

name: cc9a1cd6072bbd2a
text: The Prime Meridian, the line of 0 degrees longitude, runs right through the city of Tema in Ghana!

name: afa1f5edab4d7a05
text: Out at sea, south of Ghana, it crosses the Equator.

name: b0aa1d810cc2023f
text: Ghana is one of the biggest cocoa growers in the world.

name: 4e32072b6bb34190
text: Cocoa beans grow in pods on cocoa trees, and they are used to make chocolate!

name: f43d9083b332b29e
text: Lake Volta in Ghana is one of the biggest human-made lakes in the world.

name: 2f3d2881f497b164
text: It formed when the Akosombo Dam was built across the Volta River.

name: c3f8d52124c4f8d2
text: The dam makes electricity.

name: cba36b9f3304430a
text: Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania is the tallest mountain in Africa, at almost 6 kilometres.

name: 3c54c6cd51fc0958
text: It is a sleeping volcano.

name: 3e34780d3e182952
text: It has snow on top, even though it is near the Equator!

name: c782aea413c3f925
text: The Nile is one of the two longest rivers in the world, at about 6,650 kilometres.

name: 6186410a2e785dd6
text: Scientists still debate whether the Nile or the Amazon is longer.

name: 7a136ca9acfec6db
text: It flows north into the Mediterranean Sea.

name: 6c5d82374cb78caf
text: The Sahara is the biggest hot desert in the world, almost as big as the United States!

name: b63b4cdbc7c91de1
text: Thousands of years ago, parts of it were green, with lakes, hippos and crocodiles.

name: 677e5b8faf259ace
text: Mansa Musa ruled the Mali Empire in West Africa about 700 years ago.

name: cf80f829b515e343
text: On his journey to Mecca in 1324, he carried so much gold that people talked about it for centuries.

name: 273eb69e3e9bd4a3
text: He is often called one of the richest people in history.

name: 71549e998c3275da
text: Timbuktu, in Mali, was once a great city of learning.

name: 665d76cfbef7811e
text: Scholars travelled there from far away.

name: f3c3271d0c4711c2
text: People wrote and kept thousands of books by hand, and many still survive today!

name: 3c3ce1514d250ce2
text: Great Zimbabwe is a city of stone in southern Africa, built about 600 to 900 years ago.

name: b032702a590ddbe7
text: Its huge walls stand without any mortar holding the stones together!

name: f9e8475e2bf426da
text: The country of Zimbabwe is named after it.

name: 4819e3e7a99790f4
text: Wangari Maathai from Kenya started the Green Belt Movement.

name: 367a78639b887592
text: It helped women plant tens of millions of trees across Kenya.

name: bf5752504e8e4adc
text: In 2004, she became the first African woman to win the Nobel Peace Prize.

name: 27c63b49088e374d
text: The blue whale is the biggest animal known to have ever lived.

name: 4e3f4bd8e81b3937
text: It is even bigger than the largest dinosaurs!

name: a48585ead8bbd839
text: Cats purr by quickly tightening and relaxing muscles in their throat.

name: b32c63cd0bcd187a
text: They often purr when they are happy.

name: 2515473497ecdd35
text: Sometimes they purr to calm themselves down, too!

name: afa65b87eed47c13
text: A cat uses its whiskers like measuring sticks.

name: 09360ad082f42f59
text: They help it feel whether it can fit through a gap!

name: 70e916b685f52fba
text: Cats spend more than half their lives asleep.

name: 2be91bbbbe262b4a
text: That is a lot of naps!

name: a25785de63fadfa9
text: Great question!

name: 4a487da37f69b2e1
text: I'm not sure about that exact one yet.

name: 04addeb1eb600b05
text: Here's a cat fact instead!

name: d8b8a169d3fb6c44
text: Dogs can smell thousands of times better than people!

name: ffae8233465dba3b
text: Their noses help them find things that are hidden or far away.

name: 4a73bd6eafe0eaa4
text: Every dog has a unique nose print, a bit like a human fingerprint!

name: 41f68040a945f0ed
text: Dogs can see some colours, mostly blues and yellows.

name: 6b6f400a027e3355
text: Reds and greens look more brownish to them.

name: 9b93e8fde78982e7
text: Here's a dog fact instead!

name: 3f27dae02fe69911
text: Tyrannosaurus rex had teeth about as long as bananas!

name: 6ea4210dba6a1053
text: It lived around 66 to 68 million years ago.

name: c00b4113a3bc6af4
text: Here's a T. rex fact instead!

name: 2b623899c1d40288
text: Dinosaurs lived on Earth for over 160 million years.

name: 0fdea8fa64207f44
text: Most died out about 66 million years ago, after a huge space rock hit Earth.

name: 101cde435847cbf6
text: Birds are their living relatives!

name: 38bb2c77b52fe495
text: Some dinosaurs were as small as chickens.

name: ad7dac1d44ab65ea
text: Others were longer than two buses!

name: 631c900d7a4b4d22
text: Here's a dinosaur fact instead!

name: 41aadcd0b7a313e6
text: Elephants are the largest land animals.

name: 74c42794b2fe1cd3
text: They can feel low rumbles through the ground with their feet!

name: b895f90c9f6bba59
text: An elephant's trunk has thousands of muscles.

name: 476918bf35c6fc73
text: It can pick up a peanut or lift a heavy log!

name: 8c1e52c8a61f343f
text: Elephants can't jump!

name: 76f382d6ab4ddd0a
text: They are so heavy that they always keep at least one foot on the ground.

name: 8d1c1b71fcc66a02
text: Here's an elephant fact instead!

name: a10d557a81a58938
text: A giraffe has seven bones in its neck, the same number as you!

name: 28c50de3ec23f59f
text: Each one is just much, much longer.

name: a329badac18a28fc
text: Giraffes are the tallest animals on Earth.

name: 7e459506bd00f41c
text: Their tongues can be about half a metre long!

name: 38f583192e1678d1
text: Here's a giraffe fact instead!

name: 223f19e31997db07
text: Penguins can't fly, but they are amazing swimmers.

name: 9cf74a3c0b0fa2a4
text: Emperor penguins can dive deeper than 500 metres!

name: a76f6b08b8e6cda9
text: Here's a penguin fact instead!

name: dcefb3db7f205f82
text: Dolphins sleep with half of their brain at a time.

name: fbfa1cd4ef4cacd2
text: The other half stays awake so they can keep breathing!

name: e8a537db0ee6c45b
text: Dolphins give each other names!

name: 38ed54522a1e6403
text: Each one has its own special whistle.

name: ddf4749753ef1499
text: Here's a dolphin fact instead!

name: aad8d916ba85abe5
text: Jellyfish have no brain, no heart and no bones!

name: 549d2d7aa219de3a
text: Jellyfish have been drifting in the sea for hundreds of millions of years.

name: 7932de798256d69b
text: Here's a jellyfish fact instead!

name: 8c4a5589605f4b5a
text: Bees talk by dancing!

name: 140195216116a821
text: A special waggle dance tells other bees where to find flowers.

name: 59548f6ed5d4c6ef
text: Bees make honey from sweet flower nectar.

name: ad6a6e0dfbcf606b
text: They store it in wax cells and fan it with their wings until it thickens!

name: d05380512d20fe2b
text: Honey can last for thousands of years without going bad!

name: 9353bbd8ae9b0c05
text: Here's a bee fact instead!

name: 3229f0736d22b5df
text: Ants are super strong for their size.

name: 9fe2843495da9dc7
text: Many can carry things much heavier than their own bodies!

name: f3bb6e54ef5aa06e
text: Here's an ant fact instead!

name: 0542ee2b303be111
text: Spiders have eight legs, so they aren't insects.

name: 0c4796af6cbb7854
text: Spider silk is amazingly strong for how thin it is!

name: 8c6d4deb075d9c48
text: Here's a spider fact instead!

name: 9d4df6579568128f
text: Butterflies taste with their feet.

name: 08afc3f0929f8982
text: They stand on a leaf to find out if it is good for their eggs!

name: 990f9227c4862230
text: Every butterfly starts life as a caterpillar.

name: ce79e00f23bca738
text: Inside a case called a chrysalis, its body completely changes!

name: 4e562014a00f8702
text: Here's a butterfly fact instead!

name: ba59db3f23129fb6
text: Many find food in the dark by listening to echoes!

name: e2672fca1245c0ea
text: Here's a bat fact instead!

name: e321232f70f051be
text: Owls can't move their eyes, so they turn their heads instead.

name: 744c03798d4448a8
text: They can turn them about three-quarters of the way around!

name: 52fd5cd478d4a82d
text: Here's an owl fact instead!

name: 96578ec7cb7f9d3e
text: Many frogs drink water through their skin instead of their mouths!

name: 08a73d12bd264a47
text: Here's a frog fact instead!

name: 4cd244d39d25a9e7
text: Snakes smell with their tongues!

name: 8bca9e2130a08220
text: They flick them out to collect smells from the air.

name: c9b03a817e46c711
text: Here's a snake fact instead!

name: b00b06a6f721e893
text: Hiding is only part of the story!

name: e82b550523048a6b
text: Here's a chameleon fact instead!

name: 010524e863e2db0b
text: Cheetahs are the fastest land animals.

name: c5954299d3a47148
text: They can run about 100 kilometres per hour, but only for short sprints!

name: eba4fadcfe3a8d4c
text: There are eight planets in our Solar System.

name: e1b349b57683bd75
text: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune!

name: eca2aa44d7b1808e
text: Mars looks red because its dust has lots of iron in it.

name: 46f08698f75a7eef
text: The iron has rusted, like an old bike left in the rain!

name: b41b9f32d153e9ed
text: Mars has the tallest volcano we know of, called Olympus Mons.

name: eb3ed5bdc4061aab
text: It is about two and a half times as tall as Mount Everest!

name: 68fc46527b7ed7a8
text: Here's a Mars fact instead!

name: 0f85dfea920ce501
text: Saturn's rings are made of countless chunks of ice and rock.

name: e0d2023d7acfe6a1
text: Some are tiny like dust, and some are as big as houses!

name: c8de4523d3ea66da
text: Here's a Saturn fact instead!

name: df93704fa8ba13b2
text: A black hole is a place where gravity pulls so hard that not even light can escape.

name: 47c4c32e56a8c7d3
text: Many form when giant stars collapse.

name: 9ad512771abc4371
text: Astronauts on the space station circle Earth about every 90 minutes.

name: c310911625b5376c
text: So they see about 16 sunrises every day!

name: 3d5a03ed2b316f8b
text: Gravity is a pull between things that have mass.

name: 7906a20217393419
text: Earth's gravity keeps your feet on the ground.

name: 9992fc2c5a1cfb19
text: It also keeps the Moon going around Earth!

name: 497fff3a329826fd
text: The Moon doesn't make its own light.

name: 6bed1e2892d53f77
text: We see the part that the Sun is shining on.

name: da5b16ac5cb12109
text: That part changes as the Moon travels around Earth!

name: 8d103e5e61213b4c
text: Stars are giant balls of very hot gas.

name: d08706ea0cb21c6e
text: Our Sun is a star too.

name: 565f71d43ffa303c
text: It just looks bigger because it is so close!

name: abe3102c10a89d63
text: Light is the fastest thing in the universe.

name: fa40e9318bc43523
text: In one second, it could zoom around Earth about seven times!

name: 5160ec6441e1f391
text: Lightning heats the air so fast that it bursts outwards.

name: 151b74f1af97a16b
text: That bang is thunder!

name: 21c6adb577a8e994
text: You see the flash first, because light travels faster than sound.

name: 65473104a8fbeebb
text: The Sun warms water, and it rises into the sky as invisible vapour.

name: c22a7cdd7765899e
text: High up, it cools into tiny drops that make clouds.

name: 6e77b9638e3dd88b
text: When the drops get heavy, they fall as rain!

name: 03f3c20c23f3d245
text: Snow forms when water vapour freezes into ice crystals inside cold clouds.

name: 00bc1882744c54f3
text: Almost every snowflake has six sides!

name: 0c152416d05215ed
text: A volcano is an opening in Earth's crust.

name: 0e19773d6cb3f9cc
text: Hot melted rock called magma pushes up from below.

name: b168965cdec4ee85
text: When it bursts out, we call it lava!

name: 3fcaf410491b1f65
text: Earth's outer shell is broken into giant pieces called plates.

name: df440cc7d2e8fafc
text: When they suddenly slip past each other, the ground shakes!

name: 3604996d997c1473
text: The Moon's gravity gently pulls on the oceans.

name: 5f83145518449054
text: That makes the sea rise and fall, usually twice a day.

name: 5bff68d009ef7b91
text: These are called tides!

name: ad84e25ab9ece35b
text: Plants make their own food from sunlight, water and air.

name: ba6fae26220a8f78
text: This is called photosynthesis.

name: 7dfae1133548c609
text: It also gives off the oxygen we breathe!

name: f5c7840e6d375c13
text: Your heart is a muscle about the size of your fist.

name: eabeb146f9aafb19
text: It beats around 100,000 times every day!

name: 31d97f9f6a9bfe92
text: Babies are born with more, and some join together as they grow!

name: a212f81555c49ca0
text: Your brain sends messages along nerves super fast.

name: e01c4b99fe88f71f
text: It uses about a fifth of your body's energy, even while you sleep!

name: e05ddf90f42a7179
text: Sleep helps your body grow and repair itself.

name: f9e9ff2c5fa7849e
text: It also helps your brain sort out what you learned that day!

name: 5ac888e98883f8d0
text: Scientists aren't completely sure why we yawn!

name: 1187366ca9acc892
text: One idea is that it helps cool down the brain.

name: bb1fe0d94f5072af
text: Yawns are catching, too!

name: c096d6f4411c8ebf
text: Hiccups happen when a muscle under your lungs, called the diaphragm, suddenly tightens.

name: 147ccbed42cd843b
text: Your throat snaps shut for a moment.

name: 9de0ced89c9c32ae
text: Hic!

name: 15213eb38cdda4c3
text: Magnets pull on some metals, like iron.

name: 9d33f2893ba3a5bd
text: Every magnet has a north end and a south end.

name: 52d48fe4b142da30
text: Opposite ends pull together, and matching ends push apart!

name: 54df084a4a93661f
text: A thing floats if it can push aside its own weight in water before it sinks under.

name: c23fbe54a31c8f1a
text: A steel ship is shaped to push aside lots of water, so it floats!

name: f1855112047a1e35
text: Ice floats because water spreads out when it freezes.

name: 179f8291eafba16e
text: That makes ice lighter than the same amount of liquid water!

name: 02e3e0e1344b5c0a
text: Water can be solid ice, runny liquid, or a gas called vapour.

name: 52676648a267a8df
text: Cooling and heating it changes it from one to another!

name: 42cfefe73c70a898
text: Computers follow step-by-step instructions called code.

name: a3f768e1e8b56874
text: Deep down, everything they do is made of tiny on and off signals!

name: 040db8dce4330123
text: There's no biggest number!

name: 1bb74cd029e9b595
text: You can always add one more.

name: c40b69372c6f440f
text: Mathematicians call that never-ending idea infinity.

name: ee8d95bd9c635fd7
text: The Great Pyramid of Giza was built about 4,500 years ago.

name: 264da3118144f20b
text: For thousands of years, it was the tallest building in the world!

name: 2bb0cd8a4978468d
text: Why did the maths book look sad?

name: db10b3bff0be6a0d
text: Because it had too many problems!

name: ee0146a74a10f9e3
text: What do you call a sleeping dinosaur?

name: 48f3eb6fe2589471
text: A dino-snore!

name: 7542934a9d4bd04f
text: Why don't scientists trust atoms?

name: 4bd9040924060a34
text: Because they make up everything!

name: 4a389d6e19444da4
text: What did one ocean say to the other ocean?

name: c239b7c2688a0ebf
text: Nothing, it just waved!

name: 9447c13b3bd6e1e9
text: Feelings like that are OK, and they can change.

name: a055bde5df1146b1
text: Talking to a grown-up you trust, like a parent, carer or teacher, can really help.

name: 11d95bc60e681717
text: When you feel ready, I can tell you a joke or a fun fact.

name: 0e3438afe19943f3
text: Fish breathe with gills.

name: a0ece5c7f08ea732
text: Water flows over the gills, and they take in the oxygen mixed into the water.

name: 33a9e1dc25579b89
text: Most fish have no eyelids, so they rest with their eyes open!

name: 820842fdba047813
text: Here's a fish fact instead!

name: b067c03a956e1ecd
text: Giant pandas eat mostly bamboo.

name: 200cf33b5fe18f74
text: They can spend about half of every day munching it!

name: d58d1e28bea58ce1
text: Here's a panda fact instead!

name: d1a0ce82f46ba408
text: A lion's roar can be heard up to about 8 kilometres away!

name: a5398ace850f6791
text: Lions live in family groups called prides.
